jobs.occupation: Staff Network Reliability Engineer (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Informations-, Kommunikationstechnik)
jobs.description:
NRE Operations runs the data center networks for the entire IONOS group: the physical fabric and underlay, the SDN overlay, and the virtual network functions on top, across dozens of data centers. We are looking for a senior or staff-level engineer who operates large production networks with a reliability mindset. You define what "healthy" means, catch problems before customers do, lead the hardest incidents, and partner with NRE Automation to push routine operations toward zero manual steps. AI is central to how we work, both to make the network smarter and to make each engineer faster.

We expect every engineer here to be fluent with AI, and we mean it in two concrete ways. First, applying AI to the network itself: anomaly detection, automated diagnosis and root-cause analysis, config generation and validation, smarter alerting, and runbook or agent-driven automation. Second, using AI to raise your own output: coding assistants and LLM tooling for scripting, troubleshooting, research, and documentation. Reliability work punishes blind trust, so the skill that matters most is judgment. You need to know when an AI-generated config or diagnosis is trustworthy and when it is not.

Tasks

- Own reliability of the physical fabric, SDN overlay, and virtual network functions across all IONOS data centers. Set service level objectives and drive down unplanned downtime.
- Lead incident response on major network incidents and run postmortems that produce lasting fixes.
- Remove toil through automation, working with NRE Automation on pipelines and tooling for lifecycle, patching, and service configuration.
- Apply AI to operations: anomaly detection, automated diagnosis, config generation and validation, and automated remediation, with the judgment to know when AI output is trustworthy.
- Strengthen observability so problems surface before they reach customers, and shape lifecycle, upgrade, change-management, and capacity practices.
- Collaborate with NRE Provisioning on clean handovers.
- Share the on-call rotation covering the above.

Qualifications

- Extensive hands-on experience operating large-scale production data center networks (5+ years for Senior, longer for Staff).
- Deep Layer 2 and Layer 3 knowledge: routing (BGP, OSPF) and VXLAN with BGP/EVPN.
- Multi-vendor operations across Juniper and Cisco; SONiC and Netbox familiarity is a plus.
- Strong Linux fundamentals and the toolkit that goes with them (bash, tcpdump, iptables, git).
- Network automation you have built, using Python with Ansible and CI/CD on GitLab.
- A reliability-engineering mindset: SLOs, observability, incident command, postmortems, designing out toil.
- Fluent, critical use of AI in daily engineering, plus a track record or credible ideas for applying AI to network operations.
- Fluent English for international teams; German is a plus. Ownership and a calm approach when things break.

Benefits

- Hybrid working model.
- Flexible working hours through trust-based working hours.
- At some locations a subsidized canteen and various free drinks.
- Modern office space with very good transport connections.
- Various employee discounts for activities and products.
- Employee events such as summer and winter parties, as well as workshops.
- Numerous training and development opportunities.
- Various health offers, such as sports and health courses.

jobs.occupation: vEFK - Verantwortliche Elektrofachkraft / Qualified Electrician (m/f/d) (Elektrofachkraft für festgelegte Tätigkeiten)
jobs.description:
TYTAN Technologies

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.

We are seeking an experienced **vEFK (Electrical Safety Manager)** to take on formal electrical safety responsibility for our drone production facility, in accordance with DGUV Vorschrift 3 and DIN VDE 0105-100. As vEFK, you will be the designated person accountable for the safe operation, maintenance, and modification of all electrical systems and equipment across production lines, test benches, and facility infrastructure.

Your Road Map To Make an Impact

- Assume formal responsibility (per §13 DGUV V3 / VDE 0105) for electrical safety across the production facility, including assembly lines, battery test/charging stations, RF and avionics test benches, and building electrical systems
- Issue, review, and sign off on electrical work permits and switching authorizations
- Conduct and document risk assessments for electrical work (live working, lockout/tagout, isolation procedures)
- Supervise and coordinate Elektrofachkräfte (EFK) and elektrotechnisch unterwiesene Personen (EuP) on site
- Oversee inspection and testing of electrical equipment, machinery, and battery/charging infrastructure (per DGUV V3, VDE 0701-0702, and applicable Li-ion battery handling standards)
- Manage compliance with low-voltage directive, EMC requirements, and relevant drone/UAV manufacturing electrical safety standards
- Investigate electrical incidents, near-misses, and non-conformances; drive corrective actions
- Maintain documentation: circuit diagrams, inspection logs, training records, and safety instructions (Betriebsanweisungen)
- Liaise with quality, EHS, and engineering teams on electrical aspects of new production line rollouts and equipment procurement
- Train and qualify personnel on electrical safety procedures specific to drone assembly (e.g., high-density battery packs, motor/ESC testing, RF equipment)

Job requirements

- Completed vocational/technical training as Elektroniker, Elektroinstallateur, or equivalent, plus further qualification enabling appointment as vEFK (e.g., Meister, Techniker, or Ingenieur in Elektrotechnik)
- Formal written appointment eligibility as vEFK per employer's organizational delegation (Unternehmerpflichtenübertragung)
- Several years of hands-on experience in industrial electrical systems, ideally in manufacturing/production environments
- Sound knowledge of DGUV Vorschrift 3, VDE 0100/0105, VDE 0701-0702, and low-voltage directive requirements
- Experience with battery systems (Li-Po/Li-ion) and their associated electrical hazards is highly desirable given the UAV/drone context
- Strong documentation discipline and ability to train/supervise other electrical personnel
- Fluent German (technical/regulatory) and good working English (for international engineering teams)

Preferred / Nice to Have

- Experience in aerospace, UAV, or electronics/precision manufacturing
- Familiarity with ESD-sensitive component handling
- Knowledge of RF/EMC testing environments
- Experience with automated or semi-automated production line electrical systems

Why TYTAN?

- Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security
- Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale
- Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors
- Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback
- Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact
- Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company
- Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

- Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through Virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation
- Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit
- Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us
- Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team
- Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together
- Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands
- Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

jobs.occupation: (Junior) Data Scientist (m/f/d) Search / AI Forge (Data Scientist)
jobs.description:
Über diesen Job:
CHECK24 is the comparison portal: We are both the market leader and a dynamic startup. Working in agile teams, we make fast decisions and embrace flat hierarchies. By leveraging the latest tools and technologies as well as state-of-the-art AI methods, we drive data-driven innovation – always focusing on creating added value for our customers. Across more than 50 products, we work every day to continuously improve the user experience of our more than 20 million customers.
Our Search Team within CHECK24 AI Forge develops scalable AI solutions for search and ranking across different CHECK24 products. Search is a crucial entry and navigation point for our customers and covers challenging domains ranging from e-commerce product search and web-style navigation to travel search for hotels, destinations and other products.
Search and Ranking are among the most demanding disciplines in applied machine learning. A successful system needs to understand user intent, retrieve relevant candidates, rank them effectively and meet demanding requirements for latency, scalability and measurable customer impact.
To strengthen our team, we are looking for someone with first relevant hands-on experience who is eager to grow into a strong Applied Machine Learning Engineer. In this role, you will work on production systems combining classical information retrieval, deep learning, embeddings and Large Language Models and contribute across the entire lifecycle from initial idea and evaluation to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.
We look forward to receiving your application as a (Junior) Data Scientist (m/f/d) Search at CHECK24 AI Forge GmbH.

Was Du mitbringst:

- You have successfully completed a degree (typically a Master's) in computer science, mathematics, statistics, physics, electrical engineering or a comparable quantitative field, with strong grades in quantitative subjects
- At least one year of relevant hands-on experience in machine learning or data science is part of your background, including relevant experience gained through working-student positions, internships or your own projects
- Strong Python skills and practical experience with machine-learning or deep-learning frameworks such as PyTorch are part of your technical toolkit
- Solid classical machine-learning skills like gradient boosting, regression and feature engineering are evident in your CV, beyond LLM or RAG applications
- You have practical experience with applications based on Large Language Models, LLM evaluation, tool use or agentic workflows
- A solid understanding of machine-learning fundamentals and systematic model evaluation enables you to assess and improve model performance
- Practical experience with APIs (e.g. FastAPI), containers and Git, ideally a deployed service, complements your interest in building complete production services
- Knowledge of information retrieval, semantic search, recommender systems or learning-to-rank approaches is a plus
- You have English proficiency at C1 level or higher; German is a plus but not required

Zu Deinen Aufgaben zählen:

- You develop and improve machine-learning services for retrieval, ranking, query understanding and classification
- Hybrid search solutions combine lexical retrieval, embeddings, neural models and components based on Large Language Models
- Model development covers training, fine-tuning and systematic evaluation for semantic search, relevance prediction and learning-to-rank use cases
- You create reliable evaluation datasets and metrics and validate improvements through offline evaluations, user signals and A/B tests
- Production-ready services are built from prototypes using technologies such as Python, FastAPI, Docker, PyTorch and vector databases
- Modern AI-assisted and agentic engineering workflows enable efficient prototyping, testing and continuous improvement
- You research promising approaches in information retrieval, recommender systems and Large Language Models and translate them into measurable customer impact

Was wir Dir bieten:
Development and responsibility

- Your commitment pays off – we support your talent and provide opportunities to grow your career quickly
- Take ownership of your topics, contribute your own ideas, try new approaches and gradually assume responsibility for production Search and Ranking systems
- Benefit from internal training with specialized coaches as well as an annual budget for external professional development
Team spirit and modern workspace
- Experience team spirit in your daily work and beyond, whether over lunch, a game of table football or after-work activities, and celebrate our successes at regular company and team events
- Work in an inspiring environment with a modern office and high-quality equipment such as MacBooks and height-adjustable desks
Flexibility and balance
- Fridays are home-office optional – and spending them in the office can earn you additional vacation days on top of your 28 days
- Get to the office conveniently with your free Deutschlandticket or a subsidized company bicycle
- Enjoy a free fresh lunch twice a week and use the opportunity to connect with your colleagues
- Stay active with our internal sports classes or take advantage of our subsidized external sports offering, including EGYM Wellpass

You will be the strategic and creative engine behind these key accounts, responsible for creating robust Growth Joint Business Plans (JBPs), and owning the end-to-end execution and performance monitoring of co-marketing campaigns.

Think of it like being an artist manager for celebrity restaurants. You take local legend brands that people already love, throw the full weight of Lieferando's marketing engine behind them, and throw fuel on the fire so both sides win big.

Key Ingredients to the Role:

- Strategic Joint Business Planning: Own the marketing relationship with the restaurant partners, co-create and align on comprehensive Growth Joint Business Plans (JBPs) that drive mutual volume and brand loyalty.
- Campaign Execution & Ownership: Plan, launch, and project-manage multi-channel marketing campaigns tailored to these specific local hero chains, driving customer acquisition, engagement, and order frequency.
- Performance Monitoring & Analytics: Constantly monitor, analyze, and report on marketing performance against KPIs. Use data-driven insights to optimise ROI and uncover new growth levers for your assigned brands.
- Local Hyper-Presence: Drive impactful on-the-ground activations and hyper-local campaigns to ensure strong brand presence across all relevant physical and digital touchpoints.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the central bridge between these key restaurant partners, local sales/account management teams, and our global HQ teams (Creative Studio, CRM, Digital, PR) to execute seamless campaigns.

What will you bring to the table?

- Language & Market Expertise: Fluent in German and English (written and spoken) is essential; deep, intimate knowledge of the German consumer landscape—strong Berlin market knowledge is a major plus.
- Proven Experience: Several years of marketing experience, ideally rooted in food delivery, quick-service restaurant (QSR) marketing, tech, or account-based partner marketing.
- Commercial & Strategic Understanding: Proven experience building collaborative growth plans or joint business plans (JBPs) with external commercial partners or corporate accounts.
- Analytical Mindset: Strong data-driven instincts with the ability to monitor campaign performance, draw clear conclusions, and pivot strategies based on hard metrics.
- Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with the confidence to manage relationships with fast-moving, high-profile restaurant founders and internal corporate stakeholders alike.

The Tesla EMEA Indirect Procurement team is looking for a highly motivated Supply Chain Manager to support procurement for Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment across the broader EMEA region. You will partner closely with Engineering, Facilities, Finance, and operations stakeholders to source and manage complex service, supplies and equipment spend — from engineering consultancies, test and lab services, and specialized technical support through to engineering equipment, tooling, and infrastructure investments. This role requires a hands-on buyer who can drive end-to-end sourcing, negotiate commercial terms, ensure compliant purchase-to-pay execution, and keep critical engineering and capital programs on schedule and on budget.

What You’ll Do

- Serve as the primary Indirect Procurement partner for Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment demand across EMEA, translating business requirements into clear scopes of work, sourcing strategies, and executable purchase packages.
- Lead end-to-end sourcing for engineering services (e.g., design/engineering support, testing, prototyping services, technical consultancy, and specialized lab/operations support) and engineering supplies (e.g., lab consumables, non-production hardware, development materials) and equipment categories (tooling, fixtures, facility and infrastructure investments).
- Own RFx processes (RFI/RFP/RFQ): develop bid packages, run competitive tenders, evaluate commercial and technical proposals, and present award recommendations that balance cost, lead time, quality, risk, and supplier capability.
- Dive deep into supplier quotes and statements of work to challenge scope, pricing structures, rates, milestones, and total cost of ownership; negotiate best cost, payment terms, warranties, SLAs, and commercial protections.
- Ensure supply activation and on-time delivery for engineering development activities and capital projects, proactively managing bottlenecks, change orders, and expedites.
- Partner with Engineering, Facilities, Finance/FP&A, Legal, and Compliance to align budgets, approval thresholds, contract terms, and capital equipment spend governance requirements.
- Manage the full purchase-to-pay lifecycle for assigned categories: requisition triage, PO creation/release, goods receipt / service confirmation support, invoice issue resolution, and spend compliance.
- Build and maintain a capable regional supplier base for Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment across EMEA; drive preferred-supplier strategies, framework agreements, and multi-site leverage where beneficial.
- Track category spend, savings, cost avoidance, and risk; report status, escalations, and opportunities to Supply Chain leadership and key stakeholders.
- Work collaboratively at a cross-functional level with Engineering, Quality, Logistics, Supplier Industrialization, Legal, Finance, and other Supply Chain teams to deliver seamless operational support.
- Uphold Tesla procurement policies, ethical standards, and audit readiness across all sourcing and contracting activities.

What You’ll Bring

- You live and breathe procurement. You take ownership of assigned buying demand and ensure Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment needs stay in control from intake through delivery and payment.
- You possess a higher vocational or university qualification in a subject such as automotive engineering, mechanical engineering or business management, or equivalent experience
- Specific diploma’s Supply Chain/Purchasing are preferred
- Proven 5+ years of experience in Indirect Procurement, with hands-on ownership of Engineering Services and/or engineering equipment categories (equipment, tooling, technical services, project-related spend).
- Experience supporting manufacturing, automotive, industrial, or high-tech engineering environments is preferred; familiarity with plant/lab operations at a gigafactory or similar large industrial site is a plus.
- Strong commercial acumen: able to interpret complex SOWs, rate cards, and multi-year service proposals and negotiate cost, terms, and risk allocation.
- Comfortable operating across multiple sites and stakeholders across Tesla operations specifically in the wider EMEA region; experience with cross-border sourcing and multi-currency contracting is advantageous.
- Working knowledge of P2P / ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, or equivalent) and standard procurement governance (DOA, capital expenditure approval flows, contract lifecycle).
- Analytical, structured, and hands-on — equally effective running a strategic tender and resolving day-to-day PO, delivery, or invoice issues.
- Exceptional stakeholder management, communication and negotiation skills; ability to lead high-stakes contract discussions, challenge constructively and drive decisions at pace.
- You are fluent in English; German language skills are a strong plus.

- Direct and support the consistent implementation of company initiatives across the DACH sales organisation
- Build peer support and strong internal relationships with key management personnel across Finance, Marketing, HR, Legal, and IT

Review and update policies related to internal investigations and whistleblowing to ensure alignment with industry standards

Awareness

- Analyze case data and CCMT usage to identify trends, providing strategic insights and reports where required
- Prepare responses to media requests and provide input to Sustainability reports, Audits and other similar / related information requests

Integrity Committee

- Prepare and present Integrity Committee reports and minutes

What are you made of?

- Strong expertise in remediation and mitigation measures in an international and multicultural environment
- Exceptional ability to communicate clearly and constructively with all levels, including senior management, within a multicultural organization
- Proven ability to learn, acquire and apply new knowledge and skills in digital and investigative methodologies, laws and regulations

- High level of confidentiality and discretion

jobs.description:
The Leibniz Institute for Agricultural Engineering and Bioeconomy (ATB) is a pioneer and a driver of bioeconomy research. We create the scientific foundation to transform agricultural, food, industrial and energy systems into a sustainable bio-based circular economy. We develop and integrate techniques, processes and management strategies, effectively converging technologies to intelligently crosslink highly diverse bioeconomic production systems and to control them in a knowledge-based, adaptive and largely automated manner. We conduct research in dialogue with society, policymakers, industry and other stakeholders - knowledge-driven and application-inspired.

To support Economics of Technologies in Agriculture in the Technology Assessment Department we are seeking, at the earliest possible date a

Doctoral researcher (m/f/d) (75 %)

for the research area

„Economic analysis of innovative fenland use“

The economic analysis includes various lines of utilization of biomass from wet fenland sites and analysis of greenhouse gas abatement potentials resulting from the change in land use. Cost analysis includes approaches and cost estimates for planning, permission, management, and harvest of mixed vegetation, storage and transportation, and processing in innovative biomass utilization pathways. Labor times, costs, and potential savings from autonomous harvesting vehicles, among others, are identified. Reference uses and innovative business models are also considered to determine the economic viability of specific processes.

The aim of the project is to create a network of model and demonstration projects for the use of rewetted fens with representative fen areas, biomass utilization pathways and relevant actors in Brandenburg. Partners are in addition to ATB the Brandenburg State Office for the Environment (LfU), the University for Sustainable Development Eberswalde (HNEE), the Leibniz Centre for Agricultural Landscape Research (ZALF) and the Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences (GFZ). The WetNetBB network is part of a network of model and demonstration projects (PaludiNet) coordinated by the Thünen Institute (TI) and Greifswald Moor Centrum (GMC) as PaludiCenter. The position is assigned to the Technology Assessment Department at the ATB, and close cooperation with the Systems Process Engineering Department is intended. 

Yourtasks

- Development of models for calculating the economic potential of different utilization systems on wet fenlands
- Recording and analysis of the labour time requirements of novel forms of use of wet fenlands
- Quantitative and qualitative evaluation of scientific results
- Development of scenario-based calculations of the costs of agricultural use through paludiculture on lowland bog sites
- Presentation of project results at scientific conferences and stakeholder meetings
- Writing of scientific publications and project reports

Your qualifications

- Very good university degree in agricultural economics or related subjects (Diploma or Master of Science)
- Knowledge and experience in economic analysis of agricultural systems
- Knowledge in statistical data analysis
- Strong interest in interdisciplinary collaboration
- Very good knowledge of written and spoken English
- Very good knowledge of German for communication with stakeholders and farmers
- Ability to work in a team and willingness to cooperate, reliability, flexibility, personal commitment and independent working skills
- EU driving license class B desirable

We offer

- Encouragement and support for PhD candidates in pursuing their doctoral studies in collaboration with partner universities
- An attractive, research-intensive, and interdisciplinary working environment
- A varied position at the interface of science and practice
- Excellent infrastructure for scientific work
- Access to national and international networks for your scientific development
- Training and further education opportunities
- Family-friendly working conditions to promote work-life balance
- Participation in the VBB company ticket or Deutschlandticket
- A workplace at the edge of a picturesque landscape, easily accessible by bike or public transport

The part-time position (30 hours/week) is initially limited to 4 years. Salary will be based on your qualifications and experience according to TV-L up to pay grade E 13.

For further information, please contact Dr. Andreas Meyer-Aurich (phone +49 331 5699-222) and visit our website at www.atb-potsdam.de (http://www.atb-potsdam.de) .

Have we piqued your interest? Then apply by 30 September 2026 with your cover letter, CV (without photo), and employment references and/or contact details of referees via our online application portal for this job posting (reference number 2026-TA-3) at www.atb-potsdam.de/en/career/vacancies (http://www.atb-potsdam.de/en/career/vacancies) .

The ATB aims to increase the proportion of women among doctoral researchers and therefore explicitly encourages applications from women.

jobs.occupation: PhD Candidate in Functional Genomics and Pancreatic Cancer Research; part time 65%  (m/w/d) (Forschungsreferent/in)

Scope of duties

· Work on the project “Global mapping of drug synergy landscapes using massively parallel Cas13d genetic interaction screening” within the German Cancer Aid-funded DEFEAT-PDAC consortium
· Investigate therapeutically relevant genetic dependencies and drug combinations in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
· Perform and analyze high-throughput genetic interaction screens, particularly using Cas13d-based screening approaches
· Plan and conduct molecular and cell biological experiments to validate identified targets and drug synergies
· Investigate rational combination therapies, including combinations with RAS/KRAS inhibitors
· Work with pancreatic cancer cell lines and additional preclinical model systems
· Apply modern methods in cell biology, molecular biology, functional genomics and proteomics
· Quantitatively analyze, interpret and document experimental data
· Collaborate closely with research groups and technology platforms within the DEFEAT-PDAC network
· Present research findings at project meetings and scientific conferences and contribute to scientific publications

Our requirements

· A successfully completed university degree, preferably a Master’s degree or equivalent, in biology, biochemistry, molecular medicine, biotechnology or a related life-science discipline
· Strong interest in cancer biology, functional genomics, mechanisms of therapy resistance and translational cancer research
· Practical experience in cell and molecular biology, for example mammalian cell culture, transfection, RNA and protein analysis, immunoblotting or microscopy
· Previous experience with CRISPR-based technologies, genetic screens, proteomics, next-generation sequencing or bioinformatic data analysis is an advantage, but not mandatory
· Motivation to learn new experimental technologies and quantitative analysis methods
· A careful, structured and independent approach to scientific work
· Scientific curiosity, high motivation and enthusiasm for experimental research
· Strong communication and teamwork skills and an interest in working in an interdisciplinary and international research environment
· Very good written and spoken English
· German language skills are not required

Our offer

· An innovative and challenging PhD project within the DEFEAT-PDAC consortium, a national and internationally connected research network funded by German Cancer Aid

· An international and interdisciplinary research environment at the interface of cancer biology, functional genomics, proteomics and clinical translation
· State-of-the-art laboratories and access to advanced screening, proteomics, sequencing and data-analysis platforms
· Close collaboration with basic scientists, bioinformaticians and clinician scientists
· Structured scientific supervision and support for your professional and personal development
· Opportunities to participate in national and international conferences, workshops and training programmes
· A collaborative, supportive and inspiring working environment that encourages scientific independence and the development of your own ideas
· Employment according to the German public-sector collective agreement, including annual leave and additional benefits in accordance with the applicable regulations
· The position is initially funded for three years. Subject to a positive scientific re-evaluation, an extension for up to two additional years is possible

The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that revolutionizes entire industries. We invite you to join our dynamic group, for the unique and rewarding opportunity to contribute to upcoming products that will delight and inspire millions of Apple’s customers every day. Are you interested in doing work that challenges you, expands your thinking, provides innovative solutions for future problems while driving your growth as recognized technical leader in the cellular industry? Apple's RF Transmitter Systems Engineering team is looking for a passionate, talented individual who is eager to break technical boundaries and to change the way of doing things. Our elite team is shaping the mobile market with disruptive RF innovations while taking full responsibility for execution and commitments to schedule and quality. Join our team of leading experts in cellular RF industry and deliver differentiating transmit architectures and solutions for Apple’s wireless products that create amazing value for our customers!

Description

In this role, you will be part of an industry-leading RF Transmitter Systems Engineering team. You will work closely with other architecture- and systems engineering teams, RF design teams and SW teams to assess, specify and drive transmitter concepts with focus on leading-edge performance and uncompromised quality as baseline for differentiating products.

Responsibilities

- Your daily work includes the following tasks: 
- Translate system-level and performance requirements into requirements for the TX line-up and TX features, including RF algorithm specifications for RFICs and system firmware.
- Understand and specify RF algorithms (e.g. power control, calibration) and define the RF control infrastructure, including compute resources, interfaces, memory and timing constraints.
- Research, design, and prototype machine learning models—including neural networks and reinforcement learning—for RF transmitter applications such as power control, calibration, and digital pre-distortion.
- Develop and maintain simulation environments in Python or MATLAB to model RF systems and test AI algorithms.
- Analyze simulation data to evaluate model performance, identify trade-offs, and propose improvements.

Minimum Qualifications

- Proven years of relevant experience in RF, including cellular transmit architectures, or PhD degree with previous work on cellular topics.
- Knowledge of cellular radio/3GPP standards (GSM, UMTS, LTE, LTE-A, 5G NR), including RF aspects as well as system use cases and TX waveforms.
- Familiarity with RF systems and transceiver architecture, including lineup design and component-level trade-offs (e.g. gain, linearity, noise, power, thermal). 
- Solid theoretical grounding and hands-on experience with classical machine learning techniques (e.g., clustering, dimensionality reduction) applied to regression and classification problems.
- Solid theoretical understanding and hands-on experience with neural networks for regression and classification problems. 
- Practical experience across supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning.
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to collaborate and communicate across multicultural, global teams.
- BSEE or MSEE.
- Proficiency in English.

Preferred Qualifications

- Initial expertise in transmitter system-level concepts and control procedures like power control, digital predistortion, envelope tracking.
- Background in digital signal processing.
- Understanding of SoC integration constraints and multi-chip RF architectures.
- Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering or equivalent.

jobs.description:
The Leibniz Institute for Agricultural Engineering and Bioeconomy (ATB) is a pioneer and a driver of bioeconomy research. We create the scientific foundation to transform agricultural, food, industrial and energy systems into a sustainable bio-based circular economy. We develop and integrate techniques, processes and management strategies, effectively converging technologies to intelligently crosslink highly diverse bioeconomic production systems and to control them in a knowledge-based, adaptive and largely automated manner. We conduct research in dialogue with society, policymakers, industry and other stakeholders - knowledge-driven and application-inspired.

Scientist (PostDoc) (m/f/d) (100 %)

for the task area 

Development and validation of IoT-based sensor systems for environmental monitoring

Within the MARVELA project, innovative, cost-effective and user-friendly measurement systems for the continuous monitoring of greenhouse gases, ammonia and relevant environmental parameters at farm level will be developed, optimized and validated. At ATB, the work focuses on the further development of modular IoT-based sensor systems, the integration of sensors, embedded electronics and communication interfaces, and their application in livestock buildings and manure-management systems. The developed systems will be tested under laboratory and practical farm conditions and validated against state-of-the-art reference measurement methods.

Your tasks

- Further development and optimization of modular IoT-based sensor systems for environmental and emission monitoring
- Integration of sensors, embedded electronics, data loggers, power supplies and communication interfaces into robust measurement systems
- Programming and configuration of microcontrollers, device interfaces and automated data-acquisition systems
- Planning and conducting laboratory tests, calibrations and measurement campaigns in livestock and manure-management systems
- Validation of low-cost and mid-cost sensors against state-of-the-art reference measurement instruments
- Development and implementation of quality-assurance procedures, measurement protocols and technical documentation
- Processing, quality control, statistical analysis and interpretation of measurement data
- Coordination of technical activities with project partners and preparation of scientific publications, reports and presentations

Your qualifications

- Proven experience in scientific project management
- Proven experience in the development, integration and operation of measurement and sensor systems
- Experience with embedded systems, microcontrollers and hardware-related programming
- Knowledge of common device interfaces and communication protocols, such as I²C, SPI, UART, RS-485, Modbus, Ethernet or LoRaWAN
- Experience in sensor calibration, measurement-system validation, quality assurance and systematic troubleshooting
- Strong programming and data-analysis skills, preferably in Python, R, MATLAB, C or C++

The IRIS Institute (gGmbH) is an applied research organization creating predictive spatial models for renewable energy siting, power grid capacities, and environmental land resilience across Germany.

jobs.description:
What to Expect

We are scaling our Virtual Power Plant (VPP) operations into the German energy market and are looking for a hands-on VPP Operations Specialist – Germany to support that growth from day one. We need someone who can roll up their sleeves, own exceptions end-to-end, and bring deep practical knowledge of how the German energy market operates at a process and regulatory level.You will be embedded in our Operations team, working closely with our flexibility, settlements, and support functions across the globe. A key part of your role will be upskilling our support staff on German market workflows, participant journeys, and exception handling – ensuring the whole team can operate confidently as we grow our German footprint.

What You’ll Do

Market Operations

- Apply working knowledge of the German energy regulatory landscape (BNetzA, BDEW) to day-to-day operational tasks.
- Manage and resolve data flow exceptions relating to MaKo/EDIFACT messaging, GPKE, and WiM processes, and MSB/VNB interactions.
- Support the accurate management of MaLo and MeLo data, ensuring data integrity across systems.
- Work within the MsbG metering framework and support smart meter rollout processes relevant to VPP-connected assets.
- Demonstrate solid understanding of MaBis processes.
- Monitor Bilanzkreis and settlement obligations relevant to our flexible asset portfolio in Germany.Flexibility Participant & Exception Management
- Act as the primary handler for escalated exceptions arising from the German flexibility participant journey – from asset registration through to settlement and payment queries.
- Own complex cases end-to-end, coordinating across internal teams (settlements, tech, finance) to reach resolution.
- Identify recurring issues and escalate systemic root causes with clear data and recommended fixes.
- Support onboarding of new German flexibility participants and asset owners, ensuring a smooth and compliant process.Training & Knowledge Transfer
- Design and deliver structured training sessions for UK-based support staff covering German market processes, regulatory obligations, and participant workflows.
- Build and maintain clear, practical playbooks, process guides, and FAQs for use by the wider support team.
- Conduct regular knowledge gap assessments and adjust training content accordingly.
- Review training effectiveness and iterate based on team performance and feedback.Process Improvement & Efficiency
- Actively identify manual or repetitive tasks and find ways to reduce effort through process redesign or tooling.
- Maintain up-to-date process documentation in a clear, accessible format.
- Flag regulatory or process changes in the German market that may impact operations and recommend responses.

What You’ll Bring

Candidates should be able to demonstrate practical working knowledge across most of the following:

- BNetzA regulatory framework and BDEW market rules
- MaKo communication standards and EDIFACT message types

PhD-Student (m/f/d)

Join an interdisciplinary research project at the interface of neurobiology, RNA biology, and bioinformatics. The aim of this PhD project is to decipher the regulatory mechanisms underlying RNA dysregulation in response to environmental and viral stressors. Using innovative brain organoid models, you will apply computational and experimental approaches to investigate the effects of microplastics and/or HSV-1 infections on RNA regulation in models of Alzheimer's disease and healthy controls. The insights gained are expected to contribute to a better understanding of the development and progression of neurodegenerative diseases.

As part of this PhD project, you will employ state-of-the-art sequencing and analytical techniques to investigate how environmental factors and viral infections influence RNA regulation in the human brain. Particular emphasis will be placed on understanding the molecular mechanisms that may contribute to the onset and progression of neurodegenerative diseases.

- Analyze alterations in RNA regulation in the human brain using single-cell transcriptomics and long-read RNA sequencing.
- Investigate key RNA regulatory processes, including alternative splicing, RNA isoform usage, polyadenylation dynamics, and transposable element activity.
- Explore the effects of HSV-1 infections and genetic risk factors on RNA isoform diversity and regulation.
- Integrate and analyze transcriptomic and epitranscriptomic datasets to identify disease-relevant molecular mechanisms.
- Compare data from human brain organoid models with datasets from Alzheimer’s disease patients to assess the disease relevance of the models.
- Develop and apply bioinformatics approaches for the analysis of complex multi-omics datasets.
- Present and discuss research findings within the team and at national and international scientific conferences.
- Contribute to scientific publications in leading international peer-reviewed journals.
- Opportunity to expand the project to additional molecular layers, including proteomics, metabolomics, and lipidomics.
- Completed Master's degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Molecular Biology, Neuroscience, or a related field.
- Strong enthusiasm for RNA biology and research into neurodegenerative diseases.
- Hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas:
- Analysis of RNA sequencing and other omics datasets (bulk, single-cell, and/or long-read data)
- Programming and data analysis, particularly using Python and/or R
- Ability to work independently in a structured and goal-oriented manner.
- Strong teamwork and communication skills, with enthusiasm for collaborating in interdisciplinary and international research environments.
- Excellent written and spoken English skills.

Desirable Qualifications

- Experience in the analysis of RNA isoforms, alternative splicing, or epitranscriptomic datasets.
- Knowledge of multi-omics data integration and analysis.
- Interest in organoid models and translational biomedical research.
- Practical experience in experimental molecular biology, such as cell culture, organoid technologies, or RNA sequencing.

As a Test Equipment Engineer within the Germany division, you will be a critical contributor to test equipment design, build, and operation efforts spanning high voltage distribution, battery systems, structural and vibration validation, drive units, and drive inverters. This is a hands-on design role — you will own test solutions from concept through commissioning, working closely with validation engineers, technicians, and Tesla counterparts to ensure that the right equipment is in place to support program milestones.

What You’ll Do

- End-to-End Design: Lead the mechanical and electro-mechanical design (3D CAD, schematics, FEA) of test rigs, dynamometers, shaker fixtures, and HV distribution panels for battery, drive unit, and structural validation.
- Instrumentation & Integration: Specify and integrate sensors, actuators, and measurement equipment, collaborating with controls engineers to ensure seamless DAQ integration and CE/IEC/VDE safety compliance.
- Project Management: Own test equipment projects from concept through commissioning—managing vendors, scopes, and aggressive timelines while tracking deliverables via Jira/Confluence.
- Hands-On Commissioning: Drive the physical assembly, installation, and validation of test equipment on the shop floor, performing root-cause analysis on hardware issues.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner directly with validation engineers, technicians, and global TSE teams to translate test objectives into robust, efficient equipment requirements and author comprehensive build documentation (BOMs, MIs).

What You’ll Bring

- Education & Experience: BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or related field, with 3+ years of hands-on experience designing electro-mechanical test systems or industrial machinery. EV powertrain or HV experience is strongly preferred.
- Mechanical Engineering Core: Proficiency in 3D CAD (CATIA V5 preferred), GD&T, structural/fatigue analysis (FEA), and diverse manufacturing processes (machining, weldments, sheet metal). Experience with rotating systems and rotor dynamics is a major plus.
- Test Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge in at least one of the following areas:
High Voltage / Battery: HV circuit design, safety interlocks, thermal conditioning, or pack-level fixtures.
Structural / Vibration: Shaker table fixtures, accelerometer instrumentation, and shock profiles (IEC/MIL-STD).
Drive Unit / Inverter: Dynamometer integration, torque measurement, and EOL test hardware.
- Electrical & DAQ: Solid understanding of high-voltage safety principles, measurement instrumentation (oscilloscopes, power analyzers), automotive protocols (CAN/LIN), and test automation frameworks (LabVIEW, Python).
- Soft Skills & Culture: Exceptional hands-on aptitude, strong project management skills, and the ability to self-direct in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. Fluent English required; German language skills are a strong advantage.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Finance Business Analyst (f/m/d) for our Distribution Transformers business, covering six manufacturing locations worldwide, you will play a key role in supporting strategic Sales, T&O and DS initiatives while ensuring financial transparency and performance.
Working closely with plant controllers, performance analysts and cross-functional stakeholders, you will translate financial insights into business actions, harmonize reporting standards and contribute to productivity and cost optimization programs. Your work will help ensure that investments in innovation, digitalization and operational efficiency deliver measurable value and strengthen our position as a leading provider of reliable and sustainable transformer solutions.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Drive financial planning, budgeting, forecasting and operational excellence initiatives (e.g. productivity and cost-out programs) for Sales, T&O and DS across six global manufacturing sites.
* Consolidate, monitor and report key financial KPIs and expenditures while ensuring compliance with internal standards and external requirements.
* Prepare and analyse financial reports (e.g. Order Intake, Target Costing, Pricing and Margin Slippage) to support data-driven management decisions.
* Evaluate business cases for portfolio development, technology investments, process automation and resource optimization initiatives.
* Partner closely with Sales, Engineering, Product Management and DS teams to assess financial requirements and support strategic initiatives.
* Coordinate and guide plant controllers and performance analysts, driving standardized reporting, benchmarking and transparency across all sites.

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field.
* Proven experience in financial controlling, ideally within manufacturing, industrial or energy-related environments.
* Expertise in financial planning, forecasting and performance analysis, combined with a solid understanding of operational excellence principles.
* Experience working in a multi-site and international business environment with diverse stakeholders.
* Proficiency in ERP systems (preferably SAP) and advanced analytical and financial modelling skills.
* Excellent communication skills, fluency in English, German is an advantage and willingness to travel internationally (approximately 10–20%). 

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is 
the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

What to Expect

As a Closures Sealing Engineer, you will work with some of the industry’s brightest minds and take engineering ownership of complete static and dynamic sealing systems as well as Daylight Opening trims for Tesla vehicles. Your work will focus on static and dynamic seals for current vehicle programs, with an emphasis on quality improvement, cost reduction, and manufacturing enhancements. Additionally, you will be responsible for the engineering and design of static and dynamic seals and DLO trims for future vehicle programs.   Your ownership of seals will include initiating and overseeing both virtual (CAE) and physical testing and analysis to validate new designs from concept to production. This role provides a great opportunity to interface with all aspects of vehicle development. You will work closely with the body, closures, electrical/firmware, exterior, and interior teams, as well as with manufacturing engineering, to establish world-class seal and trim designs along with world-class assembly processes.  

What You’ll Do

- Serve as a member of the Vehicle Engineering Team, supporting closure system static and dynamic sealing and DLO trim development for Tesla vehicles  
- Fully specify elastomeric seal designs through the creation of specification drawings 
- Initiate seal CAE studies, interpret results, and iterate until geometry and materials meet design targets 
- Select appropriate materials for elastomeric static and dynamic seals and DLO trims 
- Understand manufacturing processes used to produce elastomeric seals, TP & metallic trims, and assembly processes 
- Achieve innovation-driven closure sealing & trims system targets for appearance, function, quality, cost, and weight 
- Establish system level architecture and functionality based on market research, design feasibility and prototyping. Creation of component specifications, and other technical design documents 
- Participate in the iterative process with the Tesla design and styling studio to deliver the optimal balance of form, function, and quality

- Manage and collaborate with key suppliers (both internal and external) to support overall vehicle development milestones and prototype/ production build events 

What You’ll Bring

- Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience, with evidence of exceptional ability 
- Minimum of 3 years of experience in the design and engineering of static/dynamic seals and exterior trims 
- Strong understanding of GD&T 
- Ability to interpret FEA results and integrate recommendations into product designs 
- Experience designing new and improved seals and trim components using design software 
- Proficiency in CAD software V5/3DX for designing 2D sections and 3D geometry of seals. Experience designing complex seal molds is a plus

Tasks & responsibilities

- Using advanced mass spectrometry-based approaches, you will identify, quantify, and profile host cell proteins and support impurity risk assessment through data-driven analyses.

- Through recombinant protein expression strategies, you will enable the in-depth characterization of selected host cell proteins under controlled experimental conditions.
- In close collaboration with downstream process development and analytics, you will investigate interactions between host cell proteins and therapeutic proteins and translate findings into risk mitigation strategies.
- As principal investigator for research and technology projects, you will lead scientific studies, oversee project execution and data interpretation, supervise students and technical staff, and communicate results effectively to stakeholders and management.

Requirements

- PhD in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Bioengineering, Chemical Engineering, Biology, or a related scientific discipline
- Strong expertise in protein biochemistry and molecular characterization, ideally including experience with host cell proteins (HCPs)
- Hands-on experience with mass spectrometry-based protein identification and quantification methods, preferably with a focus on host cell protein analysis
- Experience in MS data processing and analysis using bioinformatics tools, including both raw and processed datasets; knowledge of recombinant protein expression and purification is highly desirable
- Solid understanding of downstream processing concepts, chromatography principles, and data-driven experimental design and quantitative data analysis
- Proven ability to work independently and collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams, supported by a strong scientific publication record and excellent English communication, scientific writing, and documentation skills

The Opportunity

We are looking for an SAP HANA Performance Team Leader to plan, execute, and validate the performance of SAP HANA on Nutanix AHV and AOS. This role is responsible for qualifying our software to meet SAP benchmark targets and certifying third-party OEM servers for inclusion in SAP’s certified hardware directory.

About the Team

Nutanix's Solutions & Performance Engineering team is a globally distributed organization of architects, performance engineers, and industry specialists focused on validating, optimizing, and accelerating customer success across strategic workloads and industry ecosystems.

Your Role

- Manage a team of remote employees and subcontractors to benchmark SAP HANA and other SAP software components on bare-metal servers. Virtualize similar configurations on Nutanix AHV using the same hardware to identify and improve performance differences between virtualization and bare metal.
- Deploy and troubleshoot various SAP HANA configurations, and establish and document the Nutanix best practices for this workload.
- Identify new strategies and configurations to improve SAP HANA performance on new software versions and denser hardware specifications that expose performance issues in the platform software.
- Work with core engineering teams to troubleshoot performance issues impacting SAP HANA and determine root causes that can be corrected through code changes.
- Deploy new hardware infrastructure in the SAP Linux lab in Walldorf, Germany, and manage infrastructure dependencies.
- Build strong relationships at SAP Headquarters in Walldorf, Germany to gain support from key stakeholders.
- Align Nutanix strategic outcomes with SAP strategic outcomes and influence SAP stakeholders to support Nutanix goals.
- Guide teams in using SAP HANA test harness tools, including SAP validation and certification suites. Serve as a subject matter expert to support performance teams in qualifying and certifying our solution.
- Analyze results from SAP validation and certification suites, compare them to SAP's KPI thresholds, diagnose failures, and drive issues to root cause across the full stack.
- Provision, configure, and troubleshoot SAP HANA parameters, SLES/RHEL for SAP tuning, vCPU/NUMA topology, kernel scheduling, general storage topologies, virtual storage controllers, and network fabrics.
- Experience with automating hardware and software deployments, infrastructure as code, and APIs.
- Ability to explore how AI can be used to automate processes further using advanced AI models.
- Understand the impact of new CPU and memory innovations on SAP HANA workloads and how Nutanix AHV and AOS must evolve to achieve performance benchmarks close to bare metal.
- Understand both scale-up and scale-out HANA and other key architectures of the SAP HANA database.
- Assist in producing written artifacts including SAP Notes, best practice guides, test plans, and KPI result packages for SAP submissions.
- Develop sizing guidelines, configuration recommendations, and reference architectures for SAP HANA on Nutanix AHV/AOS.
- Help customers and Nutanix sellers on large deals involving SAP HANA.
- Work with hardware OEMs to enable them to achieve their own hardware validations for SAP HANA with Nutanix.
- Assist with Nutanix support escalations.

What You Will Bring

- 5+ years in SAP HANA infrastructure or general database performance engineering, with at least 2 years focused on virtualized HANA.
- Deep Linux OS experience
- Experience with Nutanix HCI
- Performance monitoring tools
- Hands-on experience running SAP HANA test harness validation and certification suites, interpreting KPI results, especially storage latency and throughput tests, and understanding the reasons for test failures.
- Working knowledge of SAP HANA, the SAP HANA hardware directory, and, ideally, SAP's certification requirements for HCI and virtualized deployments.
- Strong Linux performance skills on SLES for SAP or RHEL for SAP, including hugepages, C-states and power governors, NUMA topology, SNC2, I/O schedulers, and the standard observability toolkit (perf, sar, iostat, blktrace, numastat, ftrace).
- Practical experience with virtualization performance, including CPU pinning and NUMA alignment, vCPU-to-pCPU ratios, memory reservation, and virtual storage and network path behavior.
- Nutanix AHV/AOS experience is strongly preferred. ESXi or KVM experience will be considered if the candidate can demonstrate relevant expertise.
- Comfortable with distributed storage concepts, including replication factor, data locality, write path and oplog behavior, and understanding latency percentiles.
- Scripting for automation and analysis (Python, Bash) and familiarity with Ansible or Terraform for repeatable lab builds.
- Excellent communication skills in both English and German, with the ability to engage meaningfully with customers.

Great to have

- Direct involvement in prior SAP HANA hardware, HCI, or cloud certification submissions.
- Experience with SAP HANA System Replication, scale-out landscapes, and HA/DR validation under fault injection.
- Familiarity with SAP application-layer benchmarking (SD benchmark, BW/4HANA or S/4HANA workload profiles) in addition to infrastructure KPIs.
- Nutanix certification (NCP/NCM) or SAP HANA Technology certification.

As a Senior Consultant / Manager (f|m|x), you advise our clients in
the banking sector and financial services industry on complex topics
related to liquidity and market price risk. You analyze their current
situation, identify new requirements early on and, together with your
team, develop tailored solutions – from the initial idea all the way
to implementation. In this role, you effectively drive the continued
development of your clients’ liquidity risk management, enabling
well‑founded decision-making. You assume subject-matter
responsibility, manage collaboration within the project and shape the
content development of our consulting approaches. Your tasks: You
support and lead exciting (sub-)projects at banks and financial
services providers in their liquidity and market price risk
management, taking full responsibility – from gap analyses and the
design of client-specific solutions through to implementation. You
develop integrated management approaches for liquidity and market
price risk, bank-wide liquidity risk stress tests and quantitative
modeling frameworks, for example for risk measurement or interest
rate, margin and liquidity cash flow analyses. In addition, you design
methodological frameworks (for example in the ILAAP context) and

net interest income (NII) simulations. As part of your role, you also

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Simulation UI (User Interface) Systems department, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working Student (d/f/m) - Simulation Control UI Software Infrastructure

You are a full time student (d/f/m), looking for a working student position and want to get to know the insights of flight simulator development? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Simulation UI Systems department as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Manching
- Start: 01.11.2026
- Duration: 12-18 months

Our department develops top-notch, high-fidelity engineering and training simulations for a variety of aircrafts, supporting the entire development lifecycle.

We are seeking a working student (d/f/m) in the context of control stations for our simulators. In addition to the overall simulation control & monitoring, these stations are used for instructing and debriefing complex military flight training sessions.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
We are seeking a highly motivated Scientist to join our Mass Spectrometry based Biomarker team within the Drug Discovery Sciences (DDS) department in Germany. You'll work at the cutting edge of drug discovery - shaping breakthrough therapies and making an immediate impact.
In this role, you will represent your scientific discipline in cross-functional teams, advance cutting-edge methods in proteomics, mass spectrometry, and molecular sciences. You will help shape "first‑in‑class" opportunities across our discovery portfolio and contribute to a culture of scientific excellence.
If you are a highly motivated scientist with proteomics background, a passion for biomarker research and translational sciences, we invite you to apply for this opportunity.
Join our team and contribute to the development of innovative therapies that improve patients' lives.
Discover our Biberach site: xplorebiberach.com﻿
Tasks & responsibilities

- In your new role, you will scientifically review requests for biomarker discovery & quantitation, will align the purpose and path-forward with our partners in project teams
- Furthermore, you will lead the design, execution, and analysis of proteomics experiments, including Biomarker discovery, targeted quantification, PTM identification, or interactome determination.
- You will be using Omics-platforms for translational topics, NTC confirmation, functional validation and MoA elucidation in alignment with our research & development partners.
- Moreover, a major aspect of this role involves practical lab work, including generating and analyzing proteomics samples, as well as operating and maintaining various LC-MS systems.
- With your high interest in innovative approaches, you will challenge the ‘status quo' and further advance the scientific and proteomics workflows.
- In addition, you will educate and train Boehringer Ingelheim colleagues in proteomic analysis and continue to develop scientific and drug development expertise.

Requirements

- Completed Master's degree /Phd in mass spectrometry-based proteomics, biochemistry, pharmacology, or a related scientific discipline with several years of relevant hands-on experience with data-independent acquisition (DIA) workflows on a Thermo orbitrap Astral mass spectrometer. First insights into drug discovery programs within the pharma industry is beneficial.
- Experience with state-of-the-art proteomics workflows as well as experience in sample preparation from cells and tissues for LC-MS analyses. First experience with characterizing disease-relevant animal models for translational aspects is a plus.
- Solid understanding of biochemistry, molecular mechanisms, and pharmacology relevant to drug discovery as well as conceptual understanding of biomarkers in drug discovery and development paired with first experience in this field
- Expertise in operating cutting-edge mass spectrometry platforms (Orbitrap, QTOF, etc.) and expert understanding of respective analysis software
- Analytical mindset, with a keen interest in advancing proteomic methodologies and the ability to work independently and collaboratively in an interdisciplinary research environment
- Critical and creative thinking, self-motivated to innovate
- Excellent data analysis and data management skills, as well as presentation skills
- Fluent written and spoken English and German (a plus)

Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.
Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

We are hiring a forward-thinking and results-oriented Quantitative Investment Strategist (f/m/d) to join our risklab function. This position is an early-career opportunity based in our Munich office.

Risklab is the investment and risk solutions expert function within Allianz Global Investors. More than 60 investment professionals worldwide develop advisory services and solutions tailored to the individual investment goals of our clients.

The Asset Allocation Advice & Solutions team within risklab advises institutional clients across a wide spectrum of investment needs, ranging from strategic asset allocation, asset-liability management, lifecycle advice (defined contribution), and liability-driven investment solutions to ad hoc investment-related questions.

As part of our continued growth, we are looking for a Quantitative Investment Strategist to join our team and support our lifecycle advisory and solutions business. With your interest and skills in both financial modelling and programming, you will contribute to the design and development of our in-house model infrastructure. You will collaborate with both business and technology teams to build and enhance our platform, while ensuring smooth operations. Additionally, you will be involved in the team's core services, applying your quantitative expertise to deliver state-of-the-art financial analysis.

What you will do

- Support clients invested in our lifecycle strategies across the full product offering, from the design of customized strategies to ongoing client support.
- Maintain and enhance our tool environment in collaboration with business and technology teams.
- Perform detailed quantitative and qualitative analyses centred on our clients' investment goals and derive optimal solutions for their individual investment requirements.
- Provide ongoing client advice based on quantitative simulations and analyses, working closely with the broader risklab team.
- Investigate the long-term risk characteristics of asset allocations from both historical and forward-looking perspectives and derive risk-optimal allocations.
- Develop and implement methods to further enhance our advisory and solutions offering, supporting both concept development and implementation in Python and MATLAB.

What you bring

- Master's degree (or equivalent qualification) in Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, or a related field, with a strong background in Finance or Economics; alternatively, a degree in Finance with a strong quantitative focus.
- Programming skills and experience with Python or a similar programming language (experience with MATLAB is an advantage).
- Knowledge of financial markets, asset classes, and financial instruments from both a theoretical and/or practical perspective.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel (experience with VBA is an advantage).
- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to structure and solve complex problems.
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts and solutions clearly to different audiences.
- Strong attention to detail and a continuous desire to learn.
- Ability to manage client requests efficiently, deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines, and coordinate effectively across multiple teams.
- Empathetic team player with a flexible, proactive, self-reliant, and forward-thinking mindset.
- Proficiency in both German and English.
- Experience with AI and Machine Learning

What we offer

- We empower our employees by ensuring flexible work arrangements that maintain a balance between performance, productivity, career development and personal priorities (e.g., hybrid model/ flexible working hours)
- Securing your future: Access to company pension/savings plans
- Family support (relocation/ childcare facilities)
- Company share purchasing plan
- Mental health and wellbeing programs
- Mobility solutions (Jobrad bike leasing, subvention Jobticket)
- Career opportunities within the entire Allianz Group
- Self-guided learning & development
- … and so much more!
