Your creative fieldWe are looking for two full-time, permanent Senior Frontend Developer (all genders) t o start as soon as possible . We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want within Germany to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations.

You’ll become an integral part of a new team which is going to be responsible for the creation and maintenance of Contabo's new product line. You’ll be part of a new team in a green field scenario making design, code and infrastructure decisions based on our product strategy and time-to-market.
We’re looking for brave, pragmatic risk takers who find a balance between speed and perfectionism, who participate in on-call but also proactively work with the team on improving the redundancy and up-time of our systems.

Your main focus is going to be on everything our customers can touch or use to interact with our platform – mainly GUI but also other cloud-native open source tools like terraform or CLIs etc, making sure we develop in the open with an active presence. You’ll be building on-top of an API teams and working closely with UX designers to build the best customer experience possible.

Since the product is new you’ll have the chance to develop from the ground up, develop fast, fix fast and bring learnings back into the team. Standardise API’s but also join in on shaping the design of the product with integration to design frameworks.

What convinces usYour personality, paired with:
• TypeScript 5.9 – strong production experience, you use the type system to actually prevent bugs
• Svelte 5 including client-side routing (svelte5-router); deep prior Svelte experience is not required if you're strong in TypeScript and a comparable modern reactive framework
• REST APIs – building and consuming them; comfortable with APIs that are still evolving
• Docker, Webpack 5, PostCSS – containerized builds and frontend tooling are not foreign territory
• Svelte Material UI (SMUI) or comparable component library experience
• E2E testing with Playwright and/or Cypress
• Keycloak.js or comparable SSO/OAuth implementation experience
• Fluent English skills are a must have and German language skills are a plus

We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference.

Awesome ProspectsAt Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.Additionally, we offer:
• Work the way that fits your life – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours for a healthy work-life balance and the same technical equipment at home as in the office
• Experience real freedom – Workation across the EU and in our summer office in Mallorca
• Stay active and healthy – Access to EGYM Wellpass and thousands of fitness and wellness facilities
• Enjoy exclusive perks – Attractive discounts on many products and services through our corporate benefits program
• Recharge your energy – 30 days of vacation plus additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve
• Give back – An extra day off to get involved in social activities through our Volunteer Day
• Make an impact – Take ownership and bring your ideas to life with real creative freedom
• Keep growing – Individual professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative tech environment
• Feel comfortable where you work – Modern, conveniently located offices across our European locations
• Be part of a diverse team – Work in an international environment shaped by diversity
• Create lasting memories – Company events and team activities you won’t forget

How to reach usIf you have any questions, you can reach out to Alina by email at alina.peissl@contabo.de

About us Contabo - High-quality Cloud Hosting Made in Germany!

As a leading infrastructure service provider in the field of cloud instances and dedicated servers, we have stood for first-class quality, reliability and favorable prices since our foundation in Munich in 2003. Meanwhile, more than 275,000 customers in over 190 countries trust our services.

We specialize in providing German quality to users worldwide, focusing on the stability and security of our data centers, the optimization of internal processes, and excellent customer support.

Become a part of our future-oriented company, which plays a significant role in the development of digital cloud hosting, and support us with your ideas and commitment.

Then join our team as a Senior Cost and Value Engineer for Value Management and Value Engineering (f/m/d) and actively drive sustainable value optimizations in a cross-functional environment at Siemens AG.
What we offer you

- 2 to 3 days of mobile working per week as a global standard- Development opportunities for both personal and professional growth - 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family - Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG- Appealing Siemens pension benefits

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .

You’ll make an impact by

- Leading and supporting Cost and Value Engineering (CVE) projects within Siemens AG with a focus on Value Management and Value Engineering:- You are responsible for leading value optimization projects in CVE (e.g., Value Benchmarking), in close collaboration with cross-functional teams to systematically improve the value of portfolios, systems and products.- You act as an expert for value improvement and interdependencies in ecosystems, portfolios and systems, and support our businesses in strategic projects.- You contribute your expertise in hardware/software-combined portfolios and systems to maximize business value holistically, considering customer requirements, technical feasibility and economic impacts.
- Consistent further development of Value Management and Value Engineering methods in Cost and Value Engineering:- You continuously further develop methods in Value Management and Value Engineering and ensure their consistent integration with existing CVE methods (e.g., Value Analysis, Requirements Engineering, CVE Benchmarking).- You develop Value Management methods to make interdependencies across ecosystems, portfolios, systems and products, as well as their lifecycle business impact, transparent.- You develop quantitative value approaches to evaluate and optimize hardware/software-combined portfolios and systems.- You further develop and maintain an AI-based Value Management knowledge base for the CVE community.

Your success is grounded in

- Education: A university degree with a technical or software-related background, e.g., industrial engineering, engineering, computer science or related fields.- Experience & Skills:- You have many years of professional experience in portfolio management, product management, value management or in comparable functions such as sales, business development or business-centric system architect.- You have a sound understanding of Value Management and/or Value Engineering, such as Value Analysis or similar approaches.- You have practical experience in optimizing systems and products, ideally in building technologies, electrical engineering or energy distribution.- You have a solid understanding of AI applications and how Value Management knowledge can be made accessible through AI-based solutions.- Ideally, you have already gained initial experience working with Cost and Value Engineering and/or Procurement Engineers.

jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Tasks & responsibilities

- Your primary responsibilities will include coordinating, evaluating, and conducting in silico assessments to predict mutagenicity in accordance with ICH M7, including the scientific evaluation of related literature searches.
- In close collaboration with i internal and external stakeholders, you will develop and support derisking strategies for mutagenic impurities and metabolites across different stages of project development.
- Furthermore, you will prepare scientific reports, including expert judgment on the relevance of findings, and contribute to regulatory submission documents.
- As a subject matter expert, you will advise Research & Development teams on mutagenic impurities, mutagenic metabolites, and acceptable exposure limits for mutagenic carcinogens.
- In addition, you will represent scientific results and recommendations in international project teams, discuss their implications, and support informed risk-based decision-making.
- You will also independently manage and respond to health authority inquiries related to ICH M7 topics, coordinate global project requirements, and ensure compliance with regulatory expectations and internal procedures.

Additional tasks for the Senior Principal Scientist-Role

- With regard to the global genotoxicity strategy, you will take a leading role in its implementation and further development to ensure the application of avoidance principles and scientifically sound risk assessments.
- Moreover, you will lead complex and time-critical issues with significant regulatory impact and provide recommendations to international stakeholders.
- Additionally, you will contribute to scientific committees and expert forums, foster scientific exchange, and drive the advancement of scientific standards and best practices.

Requirements

- PhD in Chemistry, Biology, Biochemistry Eor comparable scientific degree with relevant professional experience, or Master's degree in Biology or Computer Science
- Solid knowledge of mutagenicity, structural reactivity, and genetic toxicology
- Expertise in in silico mutagenicity prediction, including relevant software tools, derisking strategies, and associated genetic toxicology assays
- Experience in literature research and the use of scientific databases
- Knowledge of pharmaceutical development and the application of genetic toxicology principles in a drug development environment
- Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders, work effectively under pressure, and communicate complex scientific findings in German and English

Additional requirements for the Senior Principal Scientist-Role

- Extensive experience in applying and interpreting in silico mutagenicity assessments within pharmaceutical development
- Demonstrated capability to lead complex scientific topics and coordinate cross-functional global stakeholders
- Experience in representing scientific positions in interactions with health authorities, scientific committees, or expert forums

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Ready to contact us?
If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com

Architecture Design, implement, and continuously improve the

Ensure integration with ERP, CRM, business applications, and the wider

organization, metadata, permissions, lifecycle management, and
information classification. Define standards for document storage,
retrieval, version control, and collaboration. Ensure information
remains accessible, structured, and compliant throughout its
lifecycle. Compliance & Process Automation Translate legal,
regulatory, and business requirements into effective information
management solutions. Manage document retention, archiving, and
records management processes. Ensure compliant, audit-ready
information storage and governance. Design and optimize automated
workflows, approvals, electronic signatures, and lifecycle processes.
Drive continuous improvements in efficiency and user experience using
Microsoft 365 technologies. Digital Workplace & User Enablement Own
information management and digital workplace solutions within IT
Operations. Promote best practices for collaboration, document
management, and knowledge sharing. Evaluate and implement enhancements
that improve governance and usability. Deliver training, user
documentation, onboarding materials, and guidance for Microsoft 365,
SharePoint, DMS platforms, and emerging technologies such as Copilot.
Vendor Management & Security Manage implementation partners,
consultants, and external service providers. Ensure solution quality,
governance, security, and alignment with business objectives. Oversee
implementations, enhancements, and ongoing solution performance.
Ensure compliance with IT security standards, ISO 27001, and
information governance requirements. Collaborate with security, legal,
and compliance teams to mitigate information risks and embed privacy
and security by design. Profile Strong experience in designing
information architectures and document management solutions, including
structured storage, collaboration, and lifecycle concepts. · Hands-on
expertise in Microsoft 365, particularly SharePoint, with familiarity
in modern tools such as Copilot Studio or comparable platforms. ·
Solid understanding of data structures, metadata models, and access
management concepts, with the ability to design scalable and
user-friendly solutions. · Experience in establishing governance
frameworks and applying "compliance-by-design” principles within
systems and processes. · Good understanding of system integrations
and application landscapes, including how to connect information
management solutions with business systems (e.g. ERP, databases, SaaS
tools). · Proven ability to design and implement automated workflows
and digital processes, improving efficiency and standardisation. ·
Experience in driving user adoption and delivering
training/enablement, ensuring effective and consistent usage of
systems across the organisation. · Experience in working with
external vendors or implementation partners, ensuring quality delivery
and alignment with requirements. · Awareness of information security,
data protection, and risk mitigation practices, and ability to
incorporate them into system design. · Excellent communication
skills, with the ability to act as the central coordination point
between business stakeholders and external IT providers for
information management and governance activities. Additional

About us JUNA is on a mission to #electrifyroadfreight. Founded in
2023, we’ve had a strong start and have already deployed a
significant fleet of heavy-duty electric trucks in Europe. Our
innovative business model makes it easy and low-risk for carriers to
shift to electric logistics by offering electric trucks as a service,
a flexible pay-per-kilometer pricing structure, and access to
guaranteed utilization from large shippers. As a joint venture between
industry leaders Scania and sennder, JUNA gives customers access to
premium electric trucks and reliable revenue through access to
priority green freight. Your mission As JUNA’s (Senior) Finance
Manager, you will own the full reporting cycle across our European
entities — ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery of
financial information as we scale. You’ll work closely with external
accounting partners in multiple countries and oversee monthly
shareholder reporting. Take ownership & drive the month-end closing
process by preparing and reviewing key accounting information and
collaborating closely with external accountants to finalize the
monthly financial records. Prepare monthly accruals. Support in
preparing monthly shareholder reporting (e.g. OPEX, Vehicle P&L).
Manage communications with external accounting offices in Italy,
Netherlands, Poland, Belgium, France, and Spain. Assist external
accountants with preparation of annual reports and third-party audits.
Prepare & issue client invoices, track payment status and proactively
follow up on overdue payments. Continuously improve, streamline and
automate finance processes to drive scalability of the finance
function. What That Looks Like In the first 3–6 months: Ramp Up
Quickly: Become fully onboarded into JUNA’s finance systems and
tools, building a solid understanding of our entity structure and
reporting flows. Own Core Processes: Independently complete your first
solo month-end close accurately and on time. Build Key Relationships:
Establish reliable, trust-based working relationships with our
external accounting offices across Europe. After 12 months: Seamless
Collaboration: Work in sync with external accounting teams across all
JUNA entities, ensuring smooth coordination and minimal friction.
Trusted Owner: Be recognized as a proactive, reliable owner of the
full reporting cycle and balance sheet — the go-to person for
financial accuracy and compliance. Process Champion: Have identified
and implemented improvements to finance workflows, contributing
meaningfully to JUNA’s operational scalability. Your profile What
you bring: Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a closely related field,
coupled with 7+ years of professional experience in a relevant role.
Comfort working with external accounting partners across multiple
jurisdictions. Proficiency with accounting software and ERP systems;
experience with consolidation tools is a plus. Professional fluency in
English required; German at B2 level or above. Who you are: Sharp and
detail-oriented — you catch errors before they become problems and
take pride in numerical accuracy. Proactive and structured — you
manage your workload independently and flag issues early rather than
waiting to be asked. Reliable under deadlines — you understand that
close cycles have hard stops and you plan accordingly. Analytical
mindset — you don’t just process numbers, you understand what they
mean and can explain variances clearly. Collaborative spirit — you
work well with external partners and internal stakeholders across
different countries and functions. Bonus points if you have:
Experience with multi-entity set-up. Exposure to scaling finance
functions in a startup or fast-growth environment. Familiarity with
IFRS in addition to HGB. Experience with MOSS, Zoho Books and Atlar.
Why us? Leadership and Innovation: Work with a pioneering team
dedicated to transforming road logistics and contributing to a
sustainable future. Autonomy and Impact: We value innovation and give
you the freedom to grow in our team to make a significant impact.
Sustainability: Join a company where your work directly contributes to
reducing carbon emissions in logistics. Benefits : Join a great team
in our dog-friendly, hybrid work model with an office located at the
heart of Kreuzberg, where you’ll enjoy a relaxed, no-micromanagement
culture, regular company events, access to Urban Sports Club and L&D
budget, and an office stocked with snacks and drinks to keep you
energized. Our Company Values Think outside the truck: challenge the
internal-only status quo, prototype fast. Impact, not activity: cut
through noise, prioritize what actually matters. Own it: end-to-end
roadmap ownership, no safety net. Collaboration drives the core: daily
work with engineers, CEO, and CTO. Customer in the driver's seat:
internal or external, understand what they need. --- At JUNA, we value
authenticity, humility, and potential — so even if you don’t check
every box, we encourage you to apply. We know that diverse
backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences are what drive true
innovation. Our team is collaborative, international, and always
evolving. Come as you are — we’re excited to meet you and
hopefully welcome you on our journey to transform the logistics
industry across Europe. If you require accommodation during the hiring
process, please don’t hesitate to reach out to
mikaela.roennkvist@juna.com. Please only contact this email for
accommodation purposes.

Company Description About EIT RawMaterials As the world moves towards
a greener future, the demand for raw materials—minerals and
metals—is set to increase immensely over the next three decades.
Europe faces a critical challenge in securing a stable supply of these
essential resources. This challenge is where EIT RawMaterials steps
in. EIT RawMaterials is at the forefront of driving innovation and
sustainability in the raw materials sector. As an Innovation Community
within the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), we
collaborate with over 300 partners across industry, academia, and
research institutes. Together, we forge dynamic, long-term
partnerships to develop innovative solutions that meet Europe's
growing demand for raw materials. The Role We are seeking an
experienced Head of Academies (m/f/d) to provide operational
leadership for the European Raw Materials Academy and the European
Advanced Materials Academy. The European Raw Materials Academy and the
European Advanced Materials Academy are flagship European initiatives
that develop the skills and talent needed to strengthen Europe’s
competitiveness and industrial transformation in the raw and advanced
materials sectors. Reporting to the Director of Education & Skills,
the Head of Academies is responsible for translating strategic
priorities into operational delivery and ensuring the successful
implementation, scaling, and continuous improvement of both Academies.
The Head of Academies (m/f/d) provides direct line management to three
Senior Education Managers who collectively lead a multidisciplinary
team of approximately 20 colleagues. The ideal candidate combines
operational excellence with an entrepreneurial mindset and a proven
ability to scale digital education initiatives. Success will be
measured through learner growth, program quality, operational
performance, and delivery against agreed Academy KPIs. Key
Accountabilities The Head of Academies is accountable for: 1.
Operational Delivery • Translate strategic priorities into
operational plans and ensure successful delivery against agreed
objectives, KPIs, timelines, budgets, quality standards, and
compliance requirements. • Establish and maintain effective
operational processes, governance, reporting, and continuous
improvement across both Academies. 2. Education Portfolio & Digital
Learning Platforms • Lead the operational management and continuous
improvement of the Academies' digital learning ecosystem, providing
recommendations to support strategic decision-making. • Drive
learner growth, program quality, and an excellent learner experience
through effective operational management and data-informed
decision-making. 3. Team Leadership • Lead, coach, and support the
Senior Managers responsible for Operations, Course Development, and
Partnerships. • Foster a high-performing, collaborative, and
accountable multidisciplinary team. 4. Operational Performance &
Resources • Manage operational budgets within agreed frameworks,
supplier relationships, and procurement activities to support the
successful delivery of both Academies and ensure efficient and
compliant use of resources. • Develop, monitor, and report on
Academy KPIs, analyse operational performance, identify risks and
opportunities, and recommend continuous improvement initiatives. 5.
Stakeholder Collaboration • Maintain productive relationships with
internal teams and other key stakeholders to ensure alignment,
successful delivery, and sustainable growth of both Academies. What
We’re Looking For Required • Experience leading professional
learning, education, or workforce development programs. • Proven
success scaling digital education, EdTech, or professional learning
initiatives. • Operational leadership and program management
experience, including digital learning platforms and Learning
Management Systems. • Demonstrated success leading multidisciplinary
teams and delivering against ambitious KPIs and operational
objectives. • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder
management skills. • Excellent written and spoken English. Desirable
• Background in EdTech, professional education, or corporate
learning and development. • Experience building or scaling education
academies, digital learning platforms, or comparable education
initiatives. • Familiarity with EU-funded projects, Horizon Europe,
Erasmus+, or the EIT ecosystem. • Understanding of quality
assurance, certification, credentials, and micro-credentials. •
Working knowledge of additional European languages. What We Offer •
The opportunity to lead the operational scaling of two flagship
European Academies with significant strategic impact. • Join a
committed, mission-driven team working at the intersection of
education, innovation, industry, and European policy. • Work with
leading European universities, industry partners, and public-sector
organisations to help shape the future workforce for the raw and
advanced materials sectors. • Hybrid working environment in Berlin.
• Competitive salary. Position Details • Location: Berlin,
Germany. • Contract: Full-time. • Duration: Fixed-term contract
until 2029, with the possibility of extension. • Travel: Occasional
travel within Europe is required. • Reports to: Director of
Education & Skills, EIT RawMaterials. Commitment to Diversity: EIT
RawMaterials is committed to diversity and inclusion. We encourage
applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of background.

KINDERPSYCHOLOGE (M/W/D)

CHILD PSYCHOLOGIST / KINDERPSYCHOLOGE (M/W/D) – ENGLISH-SPEAKING POSITION

Kennziffer: Child Psychologist

ABOUT US:

Joy Center Family Institute is a multidisciplinary clinic specializing in child development, emotional well-being, and family support. Located in Böblingen (Stuttgart), we serve a diverse international community, including civilians families connected to the U.S. military.

We are known for our holistic, relationship-based, and play-centered therapy approach, following developmental models like DIR/FLOORTIME. Our mission is to empower children and families while nurturing growth, connection, and emotional well-being.

WE ARE CONTINUOUSLY EXPANDING OUR TEAM AND ARE CURRENTLY HIRING:

• Clinical Child Psychologists.
• Licensed Psychotherapists (able to work in Germany).
• Occupational Therapists.
• Speech and Language Therapists.

CURRENT VACANCY: Clinical Child Psychologist / Psychotherapist.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• THERAPEUTIC WORK: Provide individual and family-based psychological therapy for children aged 2-15. Focus areas often include developmental challenges, emotional regulation, behavioral concerns, social skills, and attachment-based issues.
• DEVELOPMENTAL FOCUS: Apply relationship-based, play-based models such as DIR/Floortime to foster emotional and developmental growth.
• ASSESSMENTS: Conduct psychological assessments and developmental screenings as needed.
• FAMILY SUPPORT: Engage, coach, and collaborate with parents and caregivers as part of each child's therapeutic journey.
• MULTIDISCIPLINARY TEAM COLLABORATION: Participate in regular weekly supervision and team case discussions with other psychologists, occupational therapists, and speech/language therapists.
• DOCUMENTATION: Maintain accurate, timely clinical notes and assessment reports.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

• Degree in Psychology (Master's or Doctorate level).
• Licensed as a CLINICAL PSYCHOLOGIST or PSYCHOLOGICAL PSYCHOTHERAPIST with eligibility to practice in Germany (e.g., approbation or equivalent).
• Experience working with young children and families, ideally with ages 2 to 15.
• Familiarity with developmental models such as DIR/Floortime, play therapy, or other child-centered approaches (or willingness to learn).
• English fluency (our client base is international).
• Strong interpersonal skills, flexibility, and genuine passion for child development and family-centered work.

WHAT WE OFFER:

• FULL-TIME POSITION: 40 hours per week, with a balance between clinical work (28 hours) and time for documentation, supervision, and team meetings (12 hours).
• ONGOING SUPERVISION: Weekly individual and group supervision sessions plus staff meetings for professional growth and peer support.
• PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: Opportunities for continued training and workshops.
• MULTIDISCIPLINARY ENVIRONMENT: Work alongside a diverse and supportive team of psychologists, occupational therapists, and speech-language therapists.
• MEANINGFUL WORK: Directly impact the lives of children and families in a nurturing, play-based setting.

LEARN MORE:

www.joycenterfamily.com [https://www.joycenterfamily.com/]

The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

We are looking for an IT Security Specialist to define security standards for two major data infrastructure projects in the Heidelberg-Mannheim region: (1) The Data Space Project (https://www.health-life-sciences.de/dataspace/)  of the Health + Life Science Alliance (http://www.health-life-sciences.de/) has recently been launched to develop a trusted research environment (TRE) for seven leading life sciences and biomedical research institutions in the Heidelberg-Mannheim region. (2) The German Human Genome-Phenome Archive (GHGA) (https://www.ghga.de/de/)  is part of the national program for research data infrastructures (NFDI) (https://www.nfdi.de/)  and has established a secure national omics data infrastructure, enabling the secondary use of human omics data in research.

These infrastructures are supporting the bioinformatics community with software tools for secure data/metadata storage, interactive data portals with data visualization, and streamlined data deposition and acquisition solutions. Prof. Oliver Stegle is coordinating GHGA at the DKFZ and representing the Data Space project for the DKFZ in close collaboration with the other Health + Life Science Alliance member institutions Heidelberg University, European Molecular Biology Laboratory (EMBL), Central Institute of Mental Health, Max Planck Institute for Medical Research, Heidelberg University Hospital and University Hospital Mannheim.

In order to develop the Data Space Trusted Research Environment (TRE) and the GHGA platform into a state-of-the-art infrastructure for the secure handling and analysis of genome data, we are seeking with immediate effect an IT Security Specialist.

Job description:

We are looking for a team member with substantial experience in information security and risk governance. Your role will be instrumental in technical and organizational decision-making for the Data Space and GHGA projects and will ensure compliance with modern standards for both infrastructures. You will be part of two tightly connected teams spanning cloud engineers, data stewards and interdisciplinary researchers with the joint mission of enabling the secure sharing of sensitive biomedical data for the scientific research community. You will have a diverse set of tasks, shaping the IT infrastructure of the Data Space TRE from the start, while also managing the IT security for the operation of the established GHGA Portal and upcoming new functionalities. Your expertise will help ensure the safe operation of the Data Space TRE and GHGA while also contributing to the development of standards in Germany and supporting their role in international efforts.

Your responsibilities :

- Analysis and documentation of current operations with respect to IT security, identifying gaps and supporting continuous improvement
- Implementation and maintenance of a framework for risk and asset management, utilizing modern tools and standards
- Creation and maintenance of an Information Security Management System (ISMS)
- Implementation and maintenance of a program for security awareness that works across multiple communication channels
- Regular monitoring of risks through third-party interactors, such as used infrastructures or sub-contractors
- Provision of information security guidance for IT projects, including the evaluation and recommendation of technical controls
- Coordination of interaction with external expertise on legal and technical IT security topics

Your Profile:

Essential Expertise:

- Proven experience with core information security frameworks (BSI IT-Grundschutz, ISO 27001) and risk management methodologies
- Hands-on background in developing and implementing risk-mitigation plans, security policies, processes, and technical controls
- Solid understanding of GDPR compliance requirements and IT infrastructure fundamentals (e.g., networking, server roles, system architecture)
- Fluency in German and English to articulate technical requirements clearly and collaborate with cross-functional teams and external partners
- Demonstrated project management skills, with the ability to work independently, solve problems creatively, and drive initiatives to completion

Advantageous Qualifications:

- Knowledge of cloud security guardrails in multi-account environments (e.g., IAM, SCP, centralized logging, encryption, network isolation)
- CISSP certification or equivalent advanced security credential

We Offer

- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level
- 30 days of vacation per year
- Flexible working hours
- Remuneration according to TV-L incl. occupational pension plan and capital-forming payments
- Possibility of mobile work and part-time work
- Family-friendly working environment
- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket
- Unleash your full potential: targeted offers for your personal development to further develop your talents
- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-being

Are you interested?

Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!

Katharina Deschler

About the Company

CHN Energy Europe Research GmbH (CHEER) is a subsidiary of CHN Energy Investment Group (China Energy) based in Berlin, Germany. Being an integral part of China Energy’s globalized research and development layout, CHEER features in integrated European-Chinese innovation culture and advanced technology, and operates business in new energy technology research and development with purposes of promoting and accelerating carbon neutrality and making its own contribution in alleviating global climate change.

Centered on the green development strategy and the strategy of innovation-driven scientific and technological development, CHEER is committed to building a world-class research institute with global competitiveness. We focus on six key R&D areas: diversified power conversion, advanced chemical engineering, hydrogen energy, artificial intelligence, energy storage, and new environmental protection technologies.

We are building teams to develop cutting-edge sustainable and affordable technologies to improve energy efficiency, protect the environment, and mitigate climate change. Our ability to excel depends on the integrity, knowledge, skill, imagination, passion, and teamwork of people like you. Currently we have openings for leading experts with a range of focus areas including energy, chemistry, and artificial intelligence. We offer competitive compensation packages and excellent benefits.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Lead the development of the AI-based “Scientific Brain” research platform, including the overall construction of AI systems; apply large language models (LLMs) to design and optimize model architectures, carry out model training, and deploy the integrated AI platform.
2. Utilize robotic technologies to perform high-throughput experiments for the rapid synthesis and screening of a vast array of material candidates, accelerating the discovery of high-performance materials.
3. Analyze experimental data from material characterization techniques; correlate material properties with catalytic performance to guide the optimization of catalyst formulations and synthesis methods, thereby enhancing reaction efficiency.
4. Apply AI-driven computational modeling techniques to predict catalyst behavior at the atomic level; simulate adsorption, activation, and reaction pathways of reactants, identify promising catalyst candidates, and guide experimental work toward the most effective design directions.
5. Continuously explore and apply new AI algorithms and techniques to optimize predictive models and improve catalyst development strategies, thereby accelerating the discovery and optimization of advanced catalysts.

Qualification Requirements:

1. Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a comparable technical field
2. Several years of relevant professional experience in AI system development, platform engineering, or a comparable field
3. Solid experience in developing AI systems or scalable platforms, with sound knowledge of distributed system architectures and large-scale data processing
4. Proficiency in Python, Java, or Go
5. Practical experience with common AI frameworks and infrastructure tools, such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Kubernetes, and Docker
6. Good knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases, cloud platforms (such as AWS or Azure), and containerized deployment technologies
7. Additional academic or professional background in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Materials Science, Chemistry, or Chemical Engineering is considered an asset
8. Knowledge of or experience in energy, energy storage, or low-carbon technology applications is highly desirable
9. Very good English skills are required; German and/or Chinese is an advantage.

We Offer

- Competitive compensation and benefits: We offer an attractive compensation package based on the responsibilities of the role, the candidate’s qualifications, relevant professional experience, and overall fit. Additional benefits and supplementary payments may be granted in accordance with company policies and individual eligibility.
- Excellent research environment: Sufficient research funding and access to advanced digital tools and innovative technologies.
- Innovative workplace: Exciting and diverse tasks in an international R&D setting with a collaborative, open atmosphere.
- Room for creativity: Freedom to contribute your own ideas and actively shape forward-looking solutions in sustainable energy, technology, and organizational development.
- International collaboration: Interdisciplinary projects and partnerships with renowned academic and industry players across Europe, including opportunities for international exchange.
- Career development: Tailored training programs, individual career pathways, and support for participation in professional events and confe

About us

The Max-Planck-Zentrum für Physik und Medizin (MPZPM) is an interdisciplinary joint research center of the Max Planck Institute for the Science of Light (MPL), Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg (FAU), and Universitätsklinikum Erlangen (UKER). Research at MPZPM addresses fundamental questions in medicine, aiming to understand living systems, biological processes, and their pathological changes from a novel physical perspective.

Facility Leader - Lab-on-a-Chip (LoC) Facility at MPZPM
Core Facilities (CF) at MPZPM provide cutting-edge technologies and form an essential part of the center’s scientific infrastructure. The Lab-on-a-Chip (LoC) Facility is equipped with state-of-the-art microfabrication technologies housed within a cleanroom at MPZPM. LoC can also draw on the capabilities of another nanofabrication cleanroom facility at MPL. The unit supports researchers in developing advanced microfluidic chips, microtools and physiologically relevant microenvironments for studies at the interface of physics and medicine. We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Facility Head to manage and further develop the Lab-on-a-Chip facility. You will oversee daily operations, ensure safe and efficient laboratory workflows, support scientific users from diverse backgrounds and contribute to the design and development of innovative methodologies.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Management

Lead, mentor, and support scientific and technical staff, fostering a collaborative and high-performing team.
Oversee facility operations, including planning, budgeting, maintenance, and strategic development.
Train and support users from diverse scientific backgrounds.

Technical Expertise & Scientific Support

Ensure reliable operation of cleanroom infrastructure and microfabrication equipment.
Provide expert guidance in microfabrication, microfluidics, and lab-on-a-chip system development.
Contribute to the development of new microstructured materials, microfluidic chips, and advanced LoC technologies.

Innovation & Development

Support interdisciplinary research projects and facilitate knowledge transfer across scientific fields.
Develop novel microfluidics-based methodologies and provide SOPs to ensure reliable and reproducible use.
Propose and discuss organizational and infrastructure improvements with the MPZPM board, focusing on optimized workflows, state-of-the-art technologies, and strategic upgrades aligned with the institute’s priorities.
You bring:

MSc or PhD in physics, biophysics, chemistry, materials science, biomedical engineering, or a related field.
Experience in managing laboratories, particularly cleanrooms, including staff supervision and operation of microfabrication workflows.
Strong organizational, leadership, and project-management skills, with a track record of building or expanding scientific infrastructure.
Expertise in developing microfluidic technologies.
Capability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary and multicultural environment.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate across scientific disciplines. English is the primary working language; knowledge of German is advantageous.
Experience in technology transfer, device development, or industry collaboration is a plus.

Ideal Technical Competencies (some of the following):

Microfabrication & Lithography: photolithography, soft lithography, micropatterning of rigid and soft materials, biomolecule patterning via microcontact printing or LIMA photopatterning.
Microfluidics & Lab-on-a-Chip Systems: design, production, and integration of microfluidic chips with fluidic, optical and electronic components.
Soft Material Microstructuring: hydrogels, droplet microfluidics, and other soft materials relevant to biomedical applications.
3D structuring using Digital Light Processing (DLP) and Fused Deposition Modeling (FDM).

jobs.description:
Postdoc (m/f/d) – Translational Cancer Research | Gastroenterology 

Full- or part-time | temporary (36 months) | Klinik und Poliklinik für Innere Medizin II, Gastroenterologie

The Department of Internal Medicine II at TUM Klinikum rechts der Isar is recruiting a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to join our newly established Max Eder Research Group.

Our research aims to decipher the molecular mechanisms of tumor evolution, cellular plasticity, and therapy resistance in gastric and gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma (GEAC). By integrating longitudinal patient samples from prospective clinical trials with cutting-edge multi-omics technologies and functional model systems, our group is committed to understanding the biological mechanisms underlying treatment resistance in upper gastrointestinal cancers and translating these discoveries into novel therapeutic strategies.

The position offers the unique opportunity to work at the interface of clinical oncology, cancer genomics, computational biology, and functional cancer research within an outstanding translational research environment.

Your responsibilities:

You will investigate the molecular mechanisms of tumor evolution, cellular plasticity, and therapy resistance in GEAC through the integration of longitudinal multi-omics datasets from prospective clinical trial samples. 

Your research will focus on computational analysis and interpretation of large-scale molecular datasets, including:

- Analysis and integration of single-cell and spatial transcriptomic datasets to characterize tumor evolution and treatment response
- Inference of tissue-specific gene expression and tumor activity from plasma cell-free DNA fragmentation patterns
- Development of computational approaches for the integration of genomic, transcriptomic, epigenomic and immune profiling data
- Multi-omics integration to reconstruct tumor evolutionary trajectories and characterize cellular plasticity during treatment
- Development and implementation of bioinformatic pipelines for high-dimensional sequencing datasets
- Close collaboration with clinicians, biologists, computational biologists and international collaborators
- Presentation of research at international conferences and publication in high-impact scientific journals

Your profile:

We are seeking an ambitious computational scientist with a strong interest in translational cancer research and multi-omics data analysis.

Required qualifications

- PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Data Science, Biomedical Sciences, Cancer Genomics or a related quantitative discipline
- Strong experience in the analysis of next-generation sequencing data (e.g. transcriptomic and/or genomic datasets)
- Excellent programming skills in R and/or Python
- Experience working in Linux/Unix environments and using reproducible computational workflows
- Ability to independently design and drive scientific projects
- Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English

Preferred qualifications

Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:

- Cell-free DNA sequencing and fragmentation analysis (highly desirable)
- Single-cell RNA sequencing analysis and/or Spatial transcriptomics
- Multi-omics integration
- Machine learning or statistical modelling of biological datasets
- Cancer genomics and tumor evolution

We offer you:

- A postdoctoral position within a newly established and rapidly growing Max Eder Research Group funded by the German Cancer Aid
- An outstanding translational research environment embedded within TUM Klinikum rechts der Isar, one of Europe’s leading academic medical centers
- Close collaboration with internationally renowned research groups at the Institute of Cancer Research (ICR), Sutton, UK, and Chalmers University of Technology, Gothenburg, Sweden, including opportunities for scientific exchange and short-term research stays at both partner institutions.
- Direct integration with prospective clinical trials and longitudinal patient cohorts
- Close collaboration with physicians, computational biologists and internationally recognized research partners
- Strong mentorship and excellent opportunities for scientific independence and career development
- Support for national and international conference attendance
- Competitive salary according to TV-L
- EGYM Wellpass, corporate benefits, company pension scheme (VBL), cafeteria, sports and cultural offers
- Modern workplace in the heart of Munich with excellent public transport connections

We look forward to your application!

Contact: Dr. Melissa Barroux | 089 / 4140 –2251 | Klinik und Poliklinik für Innere Medizin II, Gastroenterologie

About CF Assurance (CF A)
Our mission at Controlling and
Finance Assurance (CF A) is to provide objective, factual and independent
foresight to help Siemens be excellent and to improve the overall success of
the company. As a business partner to Siemens management, we leverage our
expertise in a wide range of topics in order to create an impact. We offer an
inspiring, diverse and inclusive environment for our people to develop
professionally and personally. Our core values – being respectful, curious,
humble and open – define how we work together as a department.
To deliver on our vision of
being pioneers in assurance and a talent incubator for Siemens, CF A offers a
unique Growth and Development Model. We believe in the concept of lifelong
learning and encourage our people towards continuous upskilling as a natural
part of their career. This is your chance to build your network within the
company and become part of a diverse, international and innovative team.
About CF A Internal Control (IC)
CF A Internal Control (IC) is
the central governance department for the internal control system at Siemens.
We create impact through the definition and continuous improvement of a
state-of-the-art internal control methodology and the support of our global
internal control community in applying it. In close collaboration with
corporate governance owners, we maintain a central repository of globally
harmonized control requirements (the ‘Policy and Control Masterbook’) as well
as our ‘Risk and Internal Control (RIC) Manual’ as the foundation for the
internal control process.
As Siemens transforms
into ONE Tech Company, our IC department plays a critical role in
ensuring robust Internal Controls across the enterprise, especially over
Financial Reporting (ICFR) and Sustainability Reporting (ICSR). We are at the
forefront of leveraging innovative technologies – including Generative AI – to enhance control effectiveness, drive automation, and support
Siemens' strategic growth levers.
We are looking for a
dedicated, results-oriented pioneer who leverages their expertise and inspires
others to give their best. You are comfortable challenging established
approaches and driving change where it creates value. Be bold and apply now to become a part of our CF Assurance Internal Control team in
Munich or Erlangen.
Accelerate your career and change the world of tomorrow with us.
What You'll Do:

- Drive Innovation with Generative AI (GenAI): Ideate, design, and
implement innovative use cases leveraging GenAI to
transform IC processes – covering ideas from automated control testing and
risk assessment to intelligent documentation and anomaly detection. You
will be a key driver in exploring how GenAI can enhance control
effectiveness, efficiency, and insights.
- Shape the Future of Internal Controls Methodology: Be part of the team responsible for the
effective yet efficient design of Siemens' Internal Control methodology, especially
for IT controls of systems relevant for financial reporting (e.g.,
ITGC/ITAC) and sustainability reporting.
- Own and Evolve the IC Framework: Take responsibility
for the IT Controls part of our Internal Control System (ICS) methodology
and update the RIC Manual to reflect new methodological
developments, regulatory requirements, and technological advancements.
- Enable and Empower the Global IC Community: Coach ICS
professionals throughout the world on all aspects of the internal control
system and become the primary contact for IT Controls methodology and
emerging topics like platform- and GenAI-driven controls.
- Develop and Deliver Training & Guidance: Create and deliver
Internal Control trainings, guidance materials, and presentations to
support the global rollout of methodologies and tools, fostering a culture
of continuous learning and excellence.
- Collaborate with the External Auditor: Align and discuss
Internal Control topics and methodology with the external auditor to
ensure compliance and best-practice alignment.
- Keep Management informed: Understand global
patterns regarding IT controls of the Siemens Group and evaluate control
deficiencies, leveraging data analytics and AI-driven insights where
applicable, and be confident to bring relevant topics into management’s
view.
- Contribute Beyond IC: Engage with the
broader CF Assurance function and expand your experience through
assignments as a guest auditor, contributing to the 'CF A innovation process', or supporting cross-functional transformation initiatives.

Your Profile for "Making the Future Possible":

- Strong Academic Foundation: Degree in business
administration, information systems, finance, or related studies, ideally
a master’s degree.
- Proven IC & IT Controls Expertise: Extensive professional experience in Internal Control (including ICFR) with
a focus on IT controls. You understand the role IT systems
like SAP ERP play in an ICFR control landscape and how systems enable IT
Application Controls (ITACs) and are protected by IT General Controls
(ITGCs).
- Passion for Innovation & GenAI: Strong interest and
ideally hands-on experience in Generative AI and its
application to business processes. You are excited to explore, ideate, and
pilot GenAI use cases that drive automation, intelligence, and efficiency
in internal controls and risk management.
- Curiosity for other relevant Technologies: Genuine interest in
topics like RPA, low-code apps, AI/ML, and their potential
benefits and challenges in ICFR and ICSR environments. You stay current
with technological trends and are eager to experiment and learn.
- Growth Mindset: You enjoy taking on
new challenges and growing with them. You thrive in ambiguity and are
comfortable pioneering new approaches.
- International & Intercultural Experience: Work experience in
an international business setting and intercultural collaboration is a
strong plus, reflecting Siemens' global footprint and diverse teams.
- Adaptability & Results Orientation: You impress with
your ability to adapt to a fast-growing, dynamic environment, your focus
on results, teamwork, and customer orientation.
- Excellent Communication Skills: Strong
communication skills in German and English (written and
spoken) to engage effectively with global stakeholders.
- Digital Proficiency: Very good MS Office skills and comfort working with digital tools and
platforms. Willingness and ability to quickly learn and adopt new
technologies is essential.

Why Join Us?

- Contribute to strategic initiatives around GenAI, digital business, and innovation in the context of internal controls.
- Work at the intersection of governance, technology, and innovation, shaping the future of internal controls in
a global technology leader.
- Access to continuous learning and development opportunities, including exposure to cutting-edge
technologies like GenAI, and the chance to grow your career across
Siemens.
- Join a diverse, international, and inclusive team that values curiosity, collaboration, and bold
thinking.

Ready to pioneer the future of Internal Controls? Apply now and make an impact with us!

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) for Auxiliary Systems (Fluid Systems) of our Gas Turbines, Steam Turbines, and Generators, you will be supporting Siemens Energies growing Power Plant Project Business and be a part of our global Supply Chain network. You are responsible to secure the best performing supply base in quality, reliability, and safety and work closely with Procurement and Engineering functions in a multicultural environment. The suppliers in your scope will be the Mechanical Auxiliary Systems suppliers in Europe supplying for projects worldwide. Typical equipment in scope includes turbine air inlet, exhaust duct, expansion joint, enclosures, exhaust stack, heat exchangers, and other large, welded steel fabrications.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Supplier Monitoring: Perform supplier oversight and product inspections for regular project execution to ensure compliance with specification. Inspection types include visual, dimensional, weld, coating, pressure, traceability, quality records.
* Supplier Qualification and Development: Perform routine audits according to supplier risk categorization and audit program. Support supplier evaluation and commodity strategy definition. Implement supplier quality improvement programs or risk mitigation measures.
* Nonconformance Management: Identify and initiate containment on any identified non-conformances. Follow-up with corrective and preventive action as necessary.
* Digitalization & Process Excellence: Utilize the various Supplier Quality & Development tools and databases. E.g. to create process transparency or periodically generate supplier quality performance reports. Your ideas on how to evolve our corporate digitalization landscape, for example by leveraging agentic AI, are highly welcome.

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical, industrial engineering, or a similar discipline. Equivalent combination of education, training, and experience will be considered.
* Multiyear professional experience in supplier quality management, quality management, engineering or another related technical role in the Power Generation Industry or comparable industry related to the equipment scope mentioned above.
* Knowledge and experience in auditing. ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 Lead Auditor certification preferred.
* Knowledge in the application of quality methods such as 5 Why, FMEA, 8D, RCA.
* Familiarity with the following technologies & standards (or equivalents) are an advantage:
- Design of steel fabrications (AISC 360, EN 1090‑2, ASME VIII, B31.1, PED, API 661)
- Welding (AISC 360, AWS D1.1/ D1.2/ D1.6, ASME IX, ISO 3834, ISO 15614, ISO 5817, ISO 9606)
- Coating & surface preparation (SSPC, ISO 12944, ISO 8501, ISO 8502)
- Inspection methods (Visual Inspection, Penetrant Testing, Magnetic Particle, Ultrasonic Testing, Radiographic Testing)
- Material cleaning & preservation (ASTM A380M)
- Certifications in respective technology fields (NDT Level II or III, AMPP/ NACE CIP, FROSIO, AWS CWI/ SCWI, CSWIP 3.1/ 3.2, IWE, AWS CWEng)
* Willingness to travel as required for the role (approximately 35%) as well as strong communication skills in English.

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits

* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support the Chief Engineering Eurodrone team, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Eurodrone Overall RPAS Technical Manager (d/f/m)

Eurodrone Programme – Shaping the future of UAS

With its groundbreaking industrial and commercial setup and its unique certification and flexibility, European Medium Altitude Long Endurance (MALE) Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS) showcases how European industry can find innovative ways to support strategic autonomy needs and prepare for the Future Combat Air System. European MALE RPAS is not just the first programme to fully implement digital design manufacturing and services (DDMS). It is also seen as a ‘light-house’ programme, not only within Airbus, but also for the entire aeronautics industry in Europe.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

Technically lead and direct the overall planning and implementation to ensure the readiness and conduction of Eurodrone Phase 1C activities across all contributing organizations - including top level planning of all maintenance and RPAS updates from an overall perspective:

- Secure Flight Test Readiness of the involved test centres in Germany, Italy and Spain (e.g., training, logistics, airworthiness, operations, resources, processes).
- Provide leadership, guidance and direction on any aspects related to the maintenance, preparation and future support of the Eurodrone test fleet, associated activities (including potential FTI updates).
- Lead the installation/maintenance of a strategic fleet program.
- Support program teams to produce all technical documentations for future options.
- Act as technical customer interface for GFx management and loan requests for the use of GFx assets.
- Priories and steers equipment, GSTE and FTI spares distribution across Test Centres (Benches and RPAS prototypes), including repair management and availability of export licenses in coordination with equipment management, procurement and logistic teams.
- Execute overall management of extant or potential Cross-Program conflicts
- As the Eurodrone Engineering focal point, provide and take full responsibility for Major Asset Activity Reporting (RPAS, Benches and Equipment/Spares for BT, GT, FT, DTIS and IDTTs), supporting the program and customer reporting process (status and issues).
- Lead lessons Learned, conflict resolution, and any other matter related to whole P1C activities, amongst others RPAS bench, ground or flight testing.
- Contribute to Overall RPAS BT, GT and FT tasks allocation, considering all technical & program constraints and project directives, risks, dependencies and opportunities and underwrite the agreed output and act as escalation point of the Flight Test Management Group in case arbitration between test centers needed.
- Ensure consistency between Test Program and Certification/Qualification Plans.
- Lead adaptation of contract, if and when required.
- Coordinates and chairs: BT, GT and FT Functional Reviews (e.g., IRR, TRR, VR, FFR, Co-TRR), integrated within the Eurodrone meetings cycle, providing Program and Customer Representatives full visibility of the status of each test program
- Provide guidance, advice, recommendations or other appropriate responses to Eurodrone Chief Engineer and Program senior management on:
- the status of the BT, GT and FT program
- the status of the Eurodrone test fleet
- issues relevant to maintaining the availability of the test fleet to support present and future Eurodrone contracts.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Master's degree in Aeronautical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field.
- Minimum of 8 - 10 years of experience in Flight Test Management of multinational programs, preferably in the multinational Test Center environment.
- Minimum of 5 years of experience aerospace test and verification, with a strong focus on RPAS/UAS or complex aircraft systems.
- Proven experience in leading and managing technical teams in a demanding aerospace environment.
- In-depth knowledge of flight test methodologies, data acquisition systems, and flight test instrumentation.
- Strong understanding of aerospace safety regulations, airworthiness requirements, and certification processes (e.g., EASA, MIL-STD) with national airworthiness authorities.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
- Strong communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively interact with diverse stakeholders.
- Proficiency in German and fluency in English is required
- Spanish or Italian is a plus.
- Ability to travel as required for test campaigns and meetings.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

#MYCYM

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As the Global Head of Procurement & Logistics (f/m/d) for Digital Grid (DG), you will lead the global procurement and logistics organization and shape the function as a strategic business partner, value creator, and digital innovator. You will define and execute DG's global procurement and logistics strategy, strengthen supply chain resilience, drive operational excellence, and accelerate the adoption of AI, data, and digital technologies across the end-to-end value chain.

You will partner closely with business leaders, engineering, operations, finance, logistics, and digitalization teams to build a future-ready operating model that improves competitiveness, delivery reliability, compliance, and sustainable business performance.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Define and execute a global procurement and logistics strategy that aligns with business objectives, ensuring growth, profitability, and delivery commitments.
* Build and manage a high-performing global supplier ecosystem, driving supplier development and risk mitigation strategies to enhance material availability and business continuity.
* Champion the transformation of procurement and logistics into a data-driven function by identifying and scaling AI use cases to enhance decision-making and business performance.
* Deliver measurable business value through cost optimization, productivity improvements, and logistics efficiency, while fostering a culture of ownership, integrity, excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Lead and develop a globally distributed team, focusing on building high-performing cross-functional teams and strengthening future capabilities through talent development and inclusive leadership.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, connecting business strategy with procurement and logistics execution to drive overall organizational success.

What You Bring

* A degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Economics, Logistics, or a related field; equivalent practical experience is equally valued.
* Many years of experience in procurement, supply chain, logistics, or strategic sourcing within a global industrial or technology-driven organization.
* Several years of success in leading global and cross-functional teams, managing stakeholders across various regions and functions.
* Experience leading or contributing to analytics, automation, AI, or digital transformation initiatives in procurement, supply chain, logistics, operations, or a comparable environment.
* Strong commercial, financial, contractual, supplier management, negotiation, and risk-management expertise.
* Proficient communication in English with the ability to translate business needs into practical priorities, decisions, and measurable outcomes.

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

You have a deep understanding of the technical landscape underpinning German energy market communication — from message exchange to smart meter gateway integration — and you stay informed about relevant regulatory and technology trends. Based on your architectural expertise, your knowledge of cloud-native patterns, and your strong analytical skills, you design solutions that are both technically sound and valuable to customers.

You will define and own the architectural direction for finance-focused AI-native enterprise solutions, bridging SAP's product strategy with the realities of customer-specific delivery. The role combines deep technical leadership with close customer engagement, and requires the ability to operate credibly at both the architecture board level and on the ground with delivery teams.   You will lead the architectural direction for finance-domain AI-native solutions, driving a portfolio of customer engagements from initial proof-of-concept through to enterprise-grade production deployment.

- Reference architectures: define target and reference architectures for finance-focused autonomous AI solutions, integrating SAP S/4HANA, BTP, and Public Cloud in alignment with SAP engineering standards.

- Reusable patterns: standardize reusable architectural patterns and libraries for the finance domain, accelerating delivery across the EMEA customer portfolio.
- Agentic AI integration: design and evolve the integration of LLM, RAG, and multi-agent frameworks into finance business processes, with an emphasis on autonomous execution and auditability.

- Cloud-native mastery: deep knowledge of cloud-native architecture, MLOps, infrastructure as code, and observability stacks — with specific experience on SAP BTP, SAP S/4HANA, or Public Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) strongly valued.
- AI & agentic systems: hands-on experience with large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multi-agent system design.
- Mentorship & governance: proven ability to mentor senior engineers, enforce architectural guardrails, and drive consistent adoption of CI/CD and responsible AI practices across teams.

- Languages: business-level proficiency in both English and German is required.

Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe.

We’re looking for a passionate and highly skilled (Senior) Medical Science Liaison (MSL) to join our Medical Affairs team. Your focus will be on desmoid tumour treatment (with options to change in the future). In this field based role, you will drive scientific engagement, support clinical development, and shape our medical strategy within your assigned region. You will serve as a trusted scientific expert, build impactful relationships with KOLs, and play a key role in bringing innovative therapies to patients.

•    Build and maintain strong scientific relationships with national, regional, and local KOLs
•    Gather and communicate medical insights to inform strategy and improve patient outcomes
•    Support investigator initiated research as primary liaison
•    Provide scientific support at national and European congresses, advisory boards, and medical programs
•    Lead selected national medical projects and initiatives
•    Provide clinical presentations and information in response to unsolicited questions (as appropriate) in academic, non-academic, and healthcare provider settings
•    Collaborate with Clinical Operations to support trial site identification and patient enrollment
•    Develop and execute territory plans aligned with national and regional medical strategy
•    Partner with HEOR/Market Access to support health economic and outcomes data generation
•    Support Medical Information requests
•    Assist the Country Medical Director in shaping national KOL engagement and medical plans
•    Mentor new or less experienced MSLs
•    Support onboarding and training of field medical and commercial colleagues
•    Contribute to national and regional medical strategy as a senior team member

Who you are:
•    Advanced scientific degree (MD, PhD, PharmD or equivalent)
•    Minimum 5 years of MSL experience
•    Experience in rare diseases preferred; oncology or neuroscience a plus
•    Strong ability to communicate and present complex scientific information
•    Self driven, collaborative, and comfortable working independently

•   Valid driver license

•   German & English fluent
